osaka_wakitaya_nishitenma.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Horumon grilled in a house sauce, a horumon stew and a stamina rice bowl; yakiton and yakitori.
osaka_wakitaya_nishitenma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: offal, pork and chicken grilled over charcoal.
osaka_wakitaya_nishitenma.hours_raw: Mon–Sat, the day before and after a holiday 17:00–24:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30); closed Sundays, holidays and the 2nd and 4th Mondays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 seats, mostly a counter; smoking allowed; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Opened 6 June 2017 (Tabelog). A stamina rice bowl at lunch in January 2022.
osaka_wakitaya_nishitenma.notes: [Izakaya · 西天満, charcoal-grilled horumon] A small counter izakaya between Kitashinchi and Nishitenma, open since 2017, where the owner grills horumon, yakiton and yakitori over charcoal and makes the sauces. Start with the wagyu horumon of small intestine and the beef tataki yukhoe, then work through heart, shiro-maru and tongue; small portions make it easy to eat alone. Prices are low for the area, around ¥3,000–4,000 a head. Busy with office workers after work; smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a hidden izakaya between Kitashinchi and Nishitenma where the chef grills offal, yakiton and yakitori over charcoal, with popular shochu; opened 6 June 2017. A March 2022 diner was told the sauces are homemade by the owner; a March 2023 diner describes the owner grilling.

anecdotes.text: "I heard they are homemade by the owner." — March 2022, of the sauces.
"Everything is reasonably priced and there are small portion sizes available, perfect for enjoying a meal alone." — March 2023.
"It's bustling with salarymen after work." — February 2025.

osaka_kayou_nishiumeda_dojima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Vegetable kaiseki with a house dressing, tempura, Omi fu, Omi chicken hotpot and Omi beef sukiyaki.
osaka_kayou_nishiumeda_dojima.vegan_detail: Ask. A vegetable-led restaurant with all-you-can-eat salad, and Tabelog ticks "vegetarian options", but the courses include chicken, pork and beef hotpots and nothing is described as vegan.
osaka_kayou_nishiumeda_dojima.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30; Sunday lunch by course only) and 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); open year-round (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; after 13:00 at lunch by phone only (September 2026). Starter ¥330, not with courses (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay (Tabelog). 40 seats; private rooms for 2 to over 30; non-smoking; Osaka gold sticker for infection control (Tabelog).
osaka_kayou_nishiumeda_dojima.notes: [Japanese · Dojima, Shiga's vegetables from the farm] A forty-seat Japanese restaurant in Dojima run by a Shiga company that grows its own vegetables in Moriyama and trucks in produce from local farms each day. The signature is an all-you-can-eat 'Omi vegetable' salad, served in a flowerpot and dressed from a watering can at the table. Dinner courses from ¥4,000 add an Omi chicken hotpot or Omi beef sukiyaki, red konnyaku, tempura and seasoned rice; the ¥1,210 lunch set comes with free refills of salad and rice. Open daily, non-smoking, with private rooms.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: an Omi-vegetable restaurant supplied direct from the company's own farm in Moriyama, Shiga, and more than 300 local farmers growing over 100 varieties; four trucks collect from producers each morning; Omi beef bought whole; Lake Biwa fish. The Tabelog invoice number T5160001016157 is registered to 株式会社ガーデン, 守山市 (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02).

anecdotes.text: "The highlight was when the staff poured the dressing over the salad using a watering can, just like watering flowers!" — August 2026.
"In addition to Omi vegetables, there were also dishes featuring red konnyaku and Omi fu, which made me feel connected to Shiga." — August 2026.
"The rice is a mix of home-grown brown rice and Omi rice. This is also available for unlimited servings, which is a wonderful service." — September 2026, lunch.

osaka_deiribashi_kintsubaya.gf_detail: Ask. No ingredient information. Kintsuba is usually a red-bean square in a thin batter; abekawa mochi is rice cake in soybean flour; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_deiribashi_kintsubaya.vegan_detail: Ask. Red-bean kintsuba, abekawa mochi and isobe-maki; no ingredient information.
osaka_deiribashi_kintsubaya.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 10:00–18:00; Sat 10:00–17:00; closed Sundays; hours may change (Tabelog). Items can sell out by evening (October 2026). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; October 2026). 18 table seats for eating in; non-smoking (Tabelog).
osaka_deiribashi_kintsubaya.notes: [Sweets · Dojima, freshly made kintsuba] A wagashi shop under the expressway west of Umeda, on Tabelog's sweets lists in 2022, 2023 and 2026, known for small kintsuba made fresh each day: a thin, chewy skin around gently sweet red beans that keep their shape. Buy a box of ten for about ¥1,000, or a single piece, and eat it the same day (warm it in a toaster if not); or sit in for abekawa mochi buried in soybean flour or zenzai. Cash only; other items can sell out by late afternoon. Closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog listing (not shop-maintained): Japanese traditional sweets and a sweets café; Tabelog Japanese sweets WEST 100 in 2023 and 2026, Sweets WEST 100 in 2022; 18 table seats; cash only.

anecdotes.text: "The kintsuba was unlike any pre-made ones; the skin was soft! It must have been freshly made, as it was slightly warm!" — October 2026, a box of 10 for JPY 1100.
"When I came to Osaka, I heard that I absolutely had to try the kintsuba here, so I made my way over!" — October 2026.
"There is also an eat-in option available inside the shop." — October 2026.

osaka_kushiage_chubo_kanta_dojima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: kushiage and katsu in batter and crumbs; lunch is tonkatsu, hire-katsu, miso-katsu or kara-age set meals.
osaka_kushiage_chubo_kanta_dojima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, fish and egg skewers and katsu, with clam miso soup at lunch.
osaka_kushiage_chubo_kanta_dojima.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 (until sold out) and 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private hire for 8 or more (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog's original text says none ("なし"). Cards accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). 12 seats: a counter of 8 and a table of 4; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Opened 20 July 2003 (Tabelog).
osaka_kushiage_chubo_kanta_dojima.notes: [Kushiage · Dojima, light skewers and katsu lunches] A twelve-seat kushiage counter on a back street near Deiribashi, open since 2003, frying in all-vegetable oil to keep the skewers light. At night order the omakase skewers (five for ¥900 in 2025), with Kagoshima pork, whiting rolled in shiso and quail egg, without double-dipping. Lunch is katsu: tonkatsu or miso-katsu sets around ¥1,000 with rice, a good miso soup and a small dish, until sold out. Visitors to Osaka staying nearby come for a first taste of kushikatsu; smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: kushiage made light with 100% plant-based oil, Kagoshima "Chami Ton" pork, omakase skewers, courses and private hire, "our friendly owner will warmly welcome you"; opened 20 July 2003.

anecdotes.text: "During my visit to Osaka for sightseeing, I searched for a place near my hotel to enjoy some kushi-katsu." — June 2025, the five-skewer omakase.
"The round shape was surprising, and the fluffy texture of the fish was a revelation." — June 2025, of the whiting and shiso skewer.
"The tonkatsu was thinly cut with a light batter, so it didn't feel heavy at all." — February 2025, the hire-katsu lunch.

osaka_serena_hotel_nikko.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information on the buffet labels has been reported; carved roast beef, steak, sashimi and salads are where to start, while breads, pastries, pasta, gratins, ramen and desserts contain wheat.
osaka_serena_hotel_nikko.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegan options, but no review describes them; the buffets centre on meat, seafood and dairy.
osaka_serena_hotel_nikko.hours_raw: Daily 06:45–21:00 (last order 20:30); Saturdays and the day before holidays to 21:30 (last order 21:00). Breakfast 06:45–10:00; lunch buffet 11:30–14:30, 90 minutes; dinner buffet 17:30–20:30 on weekdays and from 17:00 at weekends and holidays, 120 minutes; à la carte 11:30–21:00 (Tabelog). A 15% service charge (Tabelog). Hokkaido Fair, 1 September–30 November 2026: weekday lunch ¥6,500, weekend and holiday lunch ¥6,800, weekday dinner ¥8,900 (Tabelog); soft drinks included at lunch, all-you-can-drink alcohol ¥3,300 (September 2026). Reservations (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD and QR (Tabelog). 101 seats and a terrace; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; hotel parking (Tabelog). Tabelog lists vegan and halal options; not described in reviews.
osaka_serena_hotel_nikko.notes: [Buffet · Shinsaibashi, Hotel Nikko Osaka's café over Midosuji] The all-day buffet café on the second floor of Hotel Nikko Osaka, right on Shinsaibashi Station, with windows over Midosuji. It runs themed fairs: until 30 November 2026 a Hokkaido Fair with jingisukan, soup curry, Hakodate shio ramen, scallop gratin from the chef's station and, at weekend lunch, build-your-own seafood bowls; winter brings crab. The carved roast beef and the desserts, especially the crème brûlée, are regular favourites, and breakfast has eggs cooked to order. Lunch is ¥6,500–¥6,800 plus 15% service. Families come back every year; one diner found dishes slow to be replenished and the mapo tofu not spicy. Open 6:45–21:00.

roles: Head chef of the café restaurant (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a café restaurant inside Hotel Nikko Osaka, directly connected to Shinsaibashi Station, serving hotel-quality buffet dishes day and night with chef-inspired creations; head chef Hideki Makihara.
chef_bio.specialty: Themed hotel buffets; carved roast beef.

anecdotes.text: "The luxurious seafood rice bowl, available only on weekends and public holidays, was a highlight, generously topped with salmon, squid, and turban shell" — September 2026, the Hokkaido Fair lunch, a fourth visit.
"However, I noticed that some dishes were not replenished frequently." — August 2026, lunch.
"I especially recommend the crème brûlée!" — August 2026, a family that has come since the children were small.

osaka_hariju_grill_dotonbori.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The steaks come with a demi-glace simmered for a week in beef-tendon broth (Tabelog), and demi-glace is usually made with flour; beef cutlet, fried shrimp, stew and hayashi rice contain wheat. Plain steak without sauce is the place to ask.
osaka_hariju_grill_dotonbori.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yoshoku restaurant.
osaka_hariju_grill_dotonbori.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and dinner 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:00); closed Tuesdays, but open on Tuesdays that are holidays or the day before a holiday, and every day in December (Tabelog). Lunch A until 14:30, with a choice of corn potage or onion soup and rice or bread (October 2026). Reservations (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 58 seats; non-smoking; takeaway (Tabelog). Prices have risen, a September 2026 regular notes.
osaka_hariju_grill_dotonbori.notes: [Yoshoku · Dotonbori, the wagyu house's Showa-era grill] The Western-style dining room of Hariju, the 1919 kuroge-wagyu house at the Dotonbori entrance, next to its sukiyaki rooms and curry shop. It is old-school yoshoku made with heifer wagyu: a beef cutlet from tenderloin, hamburg steak, beef or tongue stew and hayashi rice, or lunch plates of thin steak and fried shrimp with onion soup. Diners in 2026 loved the beef cutlet, tongue stew and retro room; others found the steak thin, tough or lukewarm for the price, a beef stew that tasted thawed, or a staff member brusque. Closed Tuesdays (except holidays and December).

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a Western-style restaurant run by Hariju, the kuroge wagyu specialist in Dotonbori, established in 1919; it uses only female kuroge wagyu, and its traditional dishes have long been loved by all ages and nationalities. The group's sukiyaki house (osaka_harijyu_dotonbori) and curry shop (osaka_harijyu_curry_shop_dotonbori) are in data; a September 2026 diner also buys bento at the butcher counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Beef cutlet; heifer-wagyu steak with week-long demi-glace.

anecdotes.text: "The beef cutlet made from tenderloin was the best ever! So tender it melted in my mouth" — October 2026, the Special Lunch, a first visit in about 30 years.
"The plate, reminiscent of a classic Western-style restaurant, included fried shrimp, fresh vegetables, ham, potato salad, and beef sauté." — October 2026, Lunch A.
"The steak was tough for the price, and while it wasn't cold, it could have been hotter." — September 2026, the steak course.

osaka_niku_bar_muu_higashishinsaibashi.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 12:00–24:00: lunch to last order 16:00 (phone bookings only for lunch; lunch may be suspended on some days), dinner 16:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Mondays, with an occasional long weekend in 31-day months; two hours when busy (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR including Alipay; no e-money (Tabelog). 30 seats: a counter of 6 and six tables for four, with high chairs (Tabelog; November 2025); smoking allowed, so no one under 20 (Tabelog). Surprise steaks for birthdays (Tabelog).
osaka_niku_bar_muu_higashishinsaibashi.notes: [Steak · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a teppan meat bar under a red awning] A small grown-up meat bar on a Higashi-Shinsaibashi corner, hung with photos of the mountains the owner has climbed, grilling thick Angus outside skirt and wagyu by weight on the teppan, with seared wagyu yukhoe made in front of you and a good wine list. Lunch brings steak and tongue sets or an oxtail soup set for about ¥1,200 with five small sides. Regulars like the friendly owner and the secret dishes announced on social media; one found it cold in winter, another the high chairs wobbly after wine. Smoking allowed (adults only); closed Mondays.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a meat stand for adults in Higashi-Shinsaibashi; the interior shows photos of mountains the owner has climbed, and the owner welcomes talk about mountains and running. 2026 reviews describe a calm chef and an energetic owner, liked by local regulars.
chef_bio.philosophy: Delicious meat without worrying about smell or smoke (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan Angus outside skirt; seared wagyu yukhoe.

anecdotes.text: "The chef prepares dishes with a calm demeanor while the energetic owner runs around the restaurant, ensuring everything runs smoothly." — July 2026, starting with the seared yukhoe.
"The steak can be ordered by weight, making it a great option for those who want to enjoy a little bit of everything." — May 2026, after 22:00.
"The restaurant was a bit too cold, but I guess that's just how it is in Osaka during winter." — January 2026, a group of five.

osaka_nikushou_gyuko_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Salted cuts and sashimi are the plainest; marinated cuts, ponzu, yukke sauce, the bread gozen and bibimbap are not described or contain wheat.
osaka_nikushou_gyuko_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a butcher-run yakiniku restaurant.
osaka_nikushou_gyuko_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); Sun 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations recommended; online bookings are confirmed by phone; same-day no-shows may be charged (Tabelog). Courses with two-hour all-you-can-drink ¥7,000, ¥8,000 and ¥10,500 (Tabelog). Lunch with free rice refills and coffee (August–September 2026); app members get free ice cream (August 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money; no service charge (Tabelog). 80 seats, private rooms for 2–6 and rooms for groups of 20 or more, some tatami; smoking allowed except at lunch; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog; September 2026). Down a flight of stairs (September 2026).
osaka_nikushou_gyuko_shinsaibashi.notes: [Yakiniku · Minami-Senba, butcher-run yakiniku with private rooms] A basement yakiniku in Minami-Senba run with a butcher shop, with private and tatami rooms and charcoal grills, one of a few Gyuko shops. Evenings bring courses with two hours of drinks from ¥7,000: tongue sashimi, meat sushi, thick tongue, three kinds of outside skirt. Lunch is the Instagram favourite: the 'Juni-hitoe' set of many small dishes around thick-cut tongue or wagyu top blade (¥2,530), with free rice refills and coffee. Diners in 2026 praise the meat for the price; one found a lunch slow (about 25 minutes), another a rice bowl less impressive than the photos. Smoking allowed at night.

roles: Staff (unnamed); meat from the group's butcher shop
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: safe, high-quality meat direct from its own butcher shop; fully private and semi-private rooms for groups up to 63. Gnavi lists other Gyuko shops in Nishinakajima, Sakaisuji Honmachi and Abiko.

anecdotes.text: "My favorite is the thinly sliced Top Blade with grated daikon and ponzu sauce." — September 2026, a second visit.
"At JPY 2,530, it offers great value!" — September 2026, the Juni-hitoe lunch.
"It took a little while to be served, about 25 minutes." — October 2026, the Juni-hitoe lunch with top blade.

osaka_yakiniku_lab_namba.notes: [Yakiniku · Namba, all-you-can-eat wagyu] An all-you-can-eat yakiniku a minute from Namba Station where even the entry course includes meat sushi, yukhoe and thick-cut tongue, ordered by QR code. Courses start at ¥5,500 with drinks; the top Kiwami course (about 130 items, steaks, uni and ikura) was ¥10,000 for the anniversary in 2026. Private rooms for dates; book ahead. Cards are VISA and Master only.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 1 May 2023 as the Namba shop of the popular 焼肉Lab in Umeda (sister shop linked on Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "About three minutes later, the staff came over and said, 'I'm sorry... it's sold out.' I had been looking forward to it the most" — May 2026, the heart sashimi at Sunday lunch.
"With the QR code ordering system, there's no need to worry about language barriers." — August 2026.
"Both lacked flavor and were overshadowed by the taste of the sauce" — April 2026, on the chicken and heart sashimi.

osaka_ujien_kissako_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog says allergy information is available; ask for it. The menu runs to parfaits with sponge cake, Mont Blancs, waffles and a matcha pasta at lunch, alongside teas and shaved ice.
osaka_ujien_kissako_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Teas (sencha, hojicha, matcha) are plant-only; the sweets use cream, ice cream and milk, and the shaved ice comes as "milk kintoki" (August 2026).
osaka_ujien_kissako_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Café (2nd floor) daily 11:00–19:45, last order 19:00; 1st-floor tea shop and Koden Yakuzen health-tea shop 10:30–21:00; open year-round (Tabelog). No reservations for café seats; bookings only for the afternoon tea set and the matcha experience (weekdays) (Tabelog). Waits of about 30 minutes at weekends (December 2025). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC and other e-money, PayPay and Alipay (Tabelog). 45 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; staff speak English, Chinese and Korean; menu with photos, on a tablet (Tabelog; December 2025). Children from primary school age order at least one item (Tabelog). Warm hojicha served instead of water (December 2025).
osaka_ujien_kissako_shinsaibashi.notes: [Japanese tea café · Shinsaibashi-suji, matcha sweets from an 1869 tea house] The second-floor café of Ujien, a tea merchant founded in 1869, right opposite Daimaru Shinsaibashi (take the lift at the back of the shop). Order a matcha or chestnut Mont Blanc or the hojicha parfait with a pot of sencha; warm hojicha comes free. No café bookings, so expect a wait at weekends; staff speak English, Chinese and Korean. Downstairs sells tea and takeaway matcha soft serve. Some reviewers find prices higher and sweets very sweet (2026).

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing and reviews: the café of Ujien, a Japanese tea shop founded in 1869 (Meiji 2) in Yamashiro, Kyoto (search results); interior art by Kosuke Watanuki (July 2025). A second café, 阪急三番街店, is in Umeda (search results).
chef_bio.specialty: Matcha and hojicha sweets; Mont Blanc.

anecdotes.text: "To my delight, instead of cold water, I was served warm hojicha in a pot. Truly a specialty tea shop!" — December 2025, after a 30-minute wait.
"Upon reviewing the menu, I felt that the prices have significantly increased compared to before." — September 2026.
"The texture was too grainy and the sweetness was overwhelming, making it hard to finish." — August 2026, a takeaway sweet.

osaka_kodawari_kome_takumi_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku and meat house.
osaka_kodawari_kome_takumi_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30; lunch last order 14:00); closures not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations online at any time; for 7 or more, phone (Tabelog). Entry needs free registration in the Takumi fan club (a LINE friend), also possible at the door (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 52 seats, a U-shaped counter after renovation, tables and private rooms for 4–20 (Tabelog; September 2026). Non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; children welcome (Tabelog). One drink per person at lunch (August 2026).
osaka_kodawari_kome_takumi_nishinakajima.notes: [Yakiniku · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, wagyu from the group’s own farm and rice cooked for your table] A 52-seat meat izakaya along the tracks five minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, in Tabelog’s Yakiniku 100 for 2023 and a Hot Restaurant in 2025 and 2026. The Takumi group raises its own Oita wagyu, and the ¥5,000–7,000 courses run from seared beef sushi and thick tongue to sukiyaki-style kalbi laid on rice; the rice itself is the other star, cooked in a clay pot for each table, with what you leave made into onigiri to take home (2026). Register free with the group’s LINE fan club to enter. Open to 23:00; lunch at weekends.

roles: Kitchen and grill staff of the 匠 group (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the group site (takumi.farm, read 2026-11-02): the 匠 group began with a barbecue business in 2010, now runs its own farm, restaurants in Nishinakajima (焼肉匠 本店, 大衆肉酒場こだわり米匠, 個室焼肉匠, ニュー焼肉食堂匠, 黒毛和牛研究所 and 豆皿おばんざい匠, opened 15 September 2026) and mail order; 15th anniversary in 2026. Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: Tabelog Yakiniku WEST 100 in 2023; Hot Restaurant 2025 and 2026; "the Takumi Group has returned to its roots ... the most important thing we must cherish at all times is our fans and customers", hence the fan-club entry. Per reviews: "Following the staff’s recommendation ... I chose the JPY 5,000 course" (October 2026); "[the staff] kindly explained the menu and recommended dishes" (September 2026); "the staff kindly made the leftovers into onigiri for us" (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Yakiniku "with white rice", as the name Kodawari Kome (particular about rice) says (Tabelog; September 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Oita wagyu courses with clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: "They serve a blend of the varieties Yume Shizuku and Tsuki Akari, which I initially thought was a bit too soft, but after some time, it became just right." — September 2026, ¥7,000 course.
"The moment it melts in your mouth, it feels like ice cream or butter dissolving." — September 2026, the large grilled beef sushi.
"I usually dislike fatty meat, but I was able to enjoy it until the end without feeling sick." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: グループのサイト (takumi.farm): 株式会社匠、大阪西中島、2010年のBBQ事業から始まり、自社牧場、飲食店 (焼肉匠 本店、大衆肉酒場こだわり米匠、個室焼肉匠、ニュー焼肉食堂匠、黒毛和牛研究所、2026年9月15日オープンの豆皿おばんざい匠)、通販、15周年。食べログ (店舗会員): 大衆肉酒場 こだわり米 匠、焼肉・ホルモン・ステーキ、大阪市淀川区西中島4-8-11 大阪屋北1号館 1F、西中島南方駅と阪急南方駅から徒歩5分、月〜金17:00〜23:00、土日祝12:00〜15:00、17:00〜23:00、不定休、カード・PayPay 可、52席、個室、禁煙、匠ファンクラブ (LINE) の登録が入店の条件、焼肉 WEST 百名店 2023、ホットレストラン 2025・2026。口コミ (2026年): 自社牧場の大分の和牛、コース5,000円・6,000円・7,000円、炙り寿司、塩タン、希少部位3種、厚切りハラミ、すき焼きカルビ、土鍋で炊くごはん (Yume Shizuku と Tsuki Akari のブレンド、1合か2合)、残りはおにぎりにして持ち帰り、ultimate yakiniku block、冷麺、テールスープ、U字のカウンター。

cultural_comfort.note: Menu with photos; staff explain the menu (Tabelog; September 2026). Entry needs a LINE fan-club registration. No English evidence found.

osaka_koshitsu_yakiniku_takumi_nishinaka.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: sauces and marinated cuts; sukiyaki-style kalbi.
osaka_koshitsu_yakiniku_takumi_nishinaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku house; raw-egg dishes.
osaka_koshitsu_yakiniku_takumi_nishinaka.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); closures not fixed; seating limited to 2 hours (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; groups of six or more may be split across neighbouring rooms (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 34 seats in rooms for 2 to 30; some rooms are partitioned rather than fully closed, and can feel small for four or get warm (Tabelog; 2026). Non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Children’s cutlery and drinks (June 2026). Opened 9 June 2016 (Tabelog).
osaka_koshitsu_yakiniku_takumi_nishinaka.notes: [Yakiniku · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, wagyu over charcoal in small private rooms] The 匠 group’s private-room yakiniku, tucked at the back of a building four minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, where small rooms with sliding doors each have a charcoal shichirin (2026). The signature is a torch-seared yukhoe wrapped in egg yolk and laid on pot-cooked rice; tongue comes four ways, and the yuzu-scented grilled horumon is unlike other places, say regulars. Order the rice early, as it takes 15 minutes. Rooms are snug and can get warm. Two-hour seating; open to 23:00, from noon at weekends.

roles: Grill staff of the 匠 group (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: private-room yakiniku, sukiyaki and sushi; opened 9 June 2016. One of the 匠 group’s restaurants in Nishinakajima (takumi.farm, read 2026-11-02). Per reviews: "No matter which location of the Takumi group I visit, the food is always delicious and offers exceptional value!" (August 2026); "The staff were all very pleasant" (August 2026); "the green onions were served separately rather than on top of the raw meat, showing the restaurant’s consideration" (August 2026); one diner found it pricey for the taste (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Grilled yukhoe with egg yolk; charcoal-grilled horumon.

anecdotes.text: "Although it’s called yukhoe, it’s served rare, lightly grilled, and wrapped in egg—absolutely delicious!" — May 2026.
"The seared horumon had a unique flavor infused with yuzu, unlike anything I’ve tasted elsewhere." — August 2026, wagyu indulgence course.
"The rice takes about 15 minutes to prepare, so it’s best to order it early." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 個室焼肉匠、焼肉・すき焼き・寿司、大阪市淀川区西中島4-8-30 サンライズビル 102、西中島南方駅と阪急南方駅から徒歩5分、月〜金17:00〜23:00、土日祝12:00〜23:00、不定休、2時間制、カード・PayPay 可、34席、2〜30名の個室、禁煙、Wi-Fi、2016年6月9日オープン。匠グループ (takumi.farm) の店。口コミ (2023年〜2026年10月): 大分の和牛、七輪の炭火、名物の炙りユッケを卵黄で包んでごはんに、ゆずの香りの炭火焼きホルモン、蒸しホルモン、4種のタン、ねぎ塩タン、部位ごとの盛り合わせ、センマイ、すき焼きカルビ、釜で炊くごはんは約15分、和牛のコース、土曜のランチコース3,850円、個室はふすまで仕切る小さな部屋、子ども用の食器、どの匠の店もおいしいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Private rooms suit families; children’s cutlery (June 2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and group site; reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_makino_maki_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fried yam, chicken nanban, grilled ramen; seasoned skewers and sesame-soy kanpachi.
osaka_makino_maki_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: vegetables rolled in pork belly or bacon; yakitori and fish.
osaka_makino_maki_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–1:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 16:00–1:00; closures not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, often needed (Tabelog; 2026). Cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 26 seats: 6 at the counter facing the grill and 16 at tables; private hire 20–50 (Tabelog; August 2026). Smoking allowed; tell the shop if you would rather people did not smoke (Tabelog). Free Wi-Fi; power outlets (Tabelog).
osaka_makino_maki_nishinakajima.notes: [Izakaya · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, Hakata vegetable-roll skewers until 1 a.m.] A 26-seat skewer bar three minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, grilling Hakata-style vegetable rolls over charcoal: lettuce wrapped in pork belly as big as a fist, Hakata green onion, shiso and pea shoots, with yakitori alongside (2026). Skewers can be ordered one at a time from about ¥400–500, and a ¥1,100 all-you-can-drink keeps a night to around ¥3,000–4,500 (2026). Sesame kanpachi and a kamameshi to finish are the other favourites. Lively and usually booked out; smoking allowed. Open to 1:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: izakaya with yakitori and kushiyaki; opposite Yakiniku Hyakuban. Per reviews: "They serve vegetable rolls that became popular in Hakata, Kyushu, and now you can find them all over the country" (August 2026); "The restaurant was lively and always packed" (September 2026); "there were many young staff members" (October 2026); a wall menu adds items missing from the printed menu (September 2026); seasoning on the vegetable skewers can be strong (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Pork-wrapped lettuce rolls and other vegetable-roll skewers.

anecdotes.text: "I was surprised by how large it was—about the size of my fist!" — October 2026, lettuce-wrapped pork.
"All the pork rolls are delicious!! Especially the Hakata green onions—they’re exquisite!!" — July 2026.
"It’s great that you can order from just one skewer! Since each order comes with 2 to 3 pieces, sharing one skewer allows you to try a variety of flavors!" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: マキノマキ、居酒屋・焼き鳥・串焼き、大阪市淀川区西中島4-7-1 チサンマンション新大阪 102、西中島南方駅と阪急南方駅から徒歩3分、Yakiniku Hyakuban の向かい、月〜金17:00〜翌1:00、土日祝16:00〜翌1:00、不定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー可、QR 不可、26席 (カウンター6、テーブル16)、貸切20〜50名、喫煙可 (希望があれば対応)、Wi-Fi、電源。口コミ (2023年〜2026年10月): Hakata の野菜巻き串を炭火で、こぶし大のレタス巻き、Hakata ねぎ、しそ、豆苗、トマトの巻き、卵とベーコン、しいたけのバター醤油、串は495円から1本でも注文できる、卵黄のつくね385円、ハツ、せせり、ごまカンパチ、焼き明太子380円、長いものフライ、チキン南蛮、ポテトサラダ、お通しの豆腐、締めに釜めしか焼きおにぎり、焼きラーメン、飲み放題1,100円 (ビールなし)、飲み放題つきコース3,500円、生ビール418円、芋焼酎、予約が必要なほどにぎやか、若いスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Wall menu and printed menu (September 2026); counter facing the grill. No English evidence found.

osaka_casablanca_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Croquettes, kara-age, cutlets and fried fugu are battered; sashimi and grilled vegetables need checking for soy sauce.
osaka_casablanca_higashimikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, shellfish, beef and pork; dashi-simmered dishes.
osaka_casablanca_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Mon, Tue and Fri–Sun 17:30–22:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; no lunch (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and often needed; the couple take only a few groups at a time (Tabelog; 2025–2026). No cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 25 seats: 5 at the counter and 20 at tables; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). Opened 8 May 1994 (Tabelog).
osaka_casablanca_higashimikuni.notes: [Izakaya · Higashi-Mikuni, a couple’s fish house with rare sake and dry curry, since 1994] A 25-seat izakaya in a quiet street four minutes from Higashi-Mikuni, run since 1994 by a couple, that looks like an old coffee shop from outside. The owner’s family runs a fish shop, and the sashimi platter of up to nine kinds is the reason to come; simmered turban shell, fugu in winter and firefly squid in spring follow, with crab croquettes and roast beef from the Western side. The sake list runs to Aramasa and Juyondai, and everyone finishes with the dry curry (¥1,000, 2024). Cash only; closed Wednesday and Thursday; book ahead.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: izakaya, seafood and yoshoku; particular about fish and sake; opened 8 May 1994. Per reviews: "The couple running the restaurant seemed quite busy" and a rare shellfish sashimi "thanks to the father’s recommendation" (May 2024); "apparently the owner’s family runs a fish shop" (December 2024); "It’s run by a couple, and [the couple] seem to manage reservations by only taking a few groups at a time" (August 2025); "run by a lovely couple" and mostly locals or regulars (June 2026); the dry curry is by "someone who has researched the art of curry to perfection" (August 2024).
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi platter; dry curry; rare sake.

anecdotes.text: "At first glance, it seems like any typical izakaya in a small town, but the quality of the fish [the shop serves] is outstanding!" — October 2024.
"The kasujiru made with Kizakiyama sake was luxurious." — February 2025.
"Sashimi - Recommended assorted platter of 9 types → Outstanding freshness! Luxurious!" — May 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カサブランカ、居酒屋・海鮮・洋食、大阪市淀川区東三国2-24-15、Midosuji Line の東三国駅1番出口から徒歩約4分、月・火・金〜日17:30〜22:00、水・木曜休み、昼の営業なし、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、25席 (カウンター5、テーブル20)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、子ども歓迎、テイクアウト、1994年5月8日オープン。口コミ (2023年〜2026年7月): 夫婦で営む、店主の実家は魚屋、市場から仕入れる魚、刺身盛り3種900円から9種まで、バイ貝やサザエの煮付け、イワシの煮付け、アジフライ、生ガキ、ホタルイカ、ふぐの白子、ふぐの唐揚げ、ウニ、アサリ、うなぎ、カニクリームコロッケ450円、唐揚げ3個500円、ひとくちヒレカツ、牛カツ、ローストビーフ、アワビの肝のグラタン、Kizakiyama の酒粕の粕汁、季節の焼き野菜、れんこん、とうもろこし、アスパラ、締めのドライカレー1,000円、Aramasa、Jikon、Juyondai、熟成の Moriizou、ごま豆腐のお通し、喫茶店のような外観。

cultural_comfort.note: Mostly locals and regulars (June 2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_warayaki_sumi_hide_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The straw-seared katsuo is served with salt and sudachi (September 2026), but the menu also has kara-age, fried octopus and other fried dishes.
osaka_warayaki_sumi_hide_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Mon and Wed 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; Tue and Thu 17:00–22:00; Fri and Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; days before and after holidays as Mon; closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; book for lunch, which fills after 12:00 (Tabelog; September 2026). Cards, e-money and QR accepted; cover charge at night (Tabelog). 27 seats with counter and sofa seats; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Courses with all-you-can-drink (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 18 September 2024 (Tabelog).
osaka_warayaki_sumi_hide_higashimikuni.notes: [Izakaya · Higashi-Mikuni, katsuo seared over straw at the counter] A fish izakaya opened in 2024 two minutes from Higashi-Mikuni Station, where the show is the warayaki: thick katsuo seared over blazing straw in view of the counter, smoky outside and rare inside, eaten with coarse salt and sudachi (2026). Lunch is a bargain at ¥1,650, warayaki with four obanzai, rice, soup and a small dessert, and fills after noon, so book (September 2026). At night add the sashimi of the day and fried dishes, with a good sake list; about ¥5,000–7,000 a head (2026). Closed Sunday; lunch Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday only.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 18 September 2024 (Tabelog). Reviewers: "The master was a wonderful person too!" (August 2026); lively staff and a calm room (September 2026).

anecdotes.text: "Watching the bonito being grilled over the blazing straw right in front of us at the counter got me excited even before tasting it." — August 2026, katsuo warayaki set meal.
"The thick cuts of fish were luxurious, with a perfect balance between the fragrant aroma of the grilled straw on the surface and the moist, rare texture inside." — September 2026.
"I recommend making a reservation since it gets fully booked after 12 PM!" — September 2026, warayaki lunch for JPY 1,650.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お魚処 藁ヤキ炭ヒデ、居酒屋・海鮮・創作料理、大阪市淀川区東三国4-16-12、東三国駅から徒歩2分、月・水 (祝前日・祝後日も) 11:30〜14:00、17:00〜22:00、火・木17:00〜22:00、金・土11:30〜14:00、17:00〜23:00、日・祝休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、チャージあり、27席、禁煙、子ども可、飲み放題のコース、2024年9月18日オープン。口コミ (2026年8〜10月): カウンターの前で藁で焼くカツオ、厚切りで中はレア、塩とすだちで、Miyagi のカツオという声、ランチ1,650円は藁焼き (カツオ、ブリ、ハマチ)、揚げ物、煮魚から選び、おばんざい4品、ごはん、みそ汁、小さなデザート (カタラーナ)、昼12時すぎは満席なので予約を、夜は本日の刺身 (ブリ)、ホタテ、鴨、から揚げ、タコの唐揚げ、タコのカルパッチョ、がんも、鶏皮、もずく酢、日本酒が多い、夜はひとり約5,000〜7,000円、マスターがいい人、外から店の中が見えにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead, especially lunch; counter seats face the straw grill. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated October 2026.

osaka_sakana_ryori_anono_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The set has sashimi, grilled fish and obanzai, but also kara-age.
osaka_sakana_ryori_anono_higashimikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish set meals with sashimi, grilled fish and kara-age.
osaka_sakana_ryori_anono_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 12:00–22:00, lunch 12:00–15:00, last entry 21:00; closed Sunday and holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted by phone, and needed for lunch, which is often fully booked; walk-ins queue before 12:00 and the whole party must be present (2026). Cards and e-money accepted (Tabelog). 8 counter seats and a table for four on the ground floor, more on the first floor (September 2026); non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 21 March 2024 (Tabelog).
osaka_sakana_ryori_anono_higashimikuni.notes: [Fish · Higashi-Mikuni, a ¥1,650 fish set with ten obanzai] A small fish restaurant opened in 2024 down an alley near Higashi-Mikuni Station, whose lunch sells out every day: the ¥1,650 Anono Gozen of sashimi, grilled fish, kara-age, omelette and about ten homemade obanzai, like a ryokan breakfast (2026). Book by phone, or queue before noon with your whole party. It stays open into the evening for a sashimi platter with nine little dishes, ¥2,800, and drinks; a noon-to-mid-afternoon drinking session for two came to ¥8,000 (2026). Closed Sunday and holidays.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 21 March 2024 (Tabelog). Reviewers: a homely room with many regulars at the counter (October 2026); attentive staff (July 2026); featured on a local TV programme (August 2026).

anecdotes.text: "The set meal included sashimi, grilled fish, small side dishes, rolled omelet, miso soup, and rice, all beautifully prepared, resembling a luxurious breakfast at a ryokan." — July 2026.
"Assorted Sashimi Platter (one slice each) + Assorted Nine Appetizers for JPY 2,800 = A solo drinking paradise." — October 2026.
"There was a notice outside stating that the lunch menu was fully booked." — August 2026, Anono Gozen.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 魚料理 あのの、食堂・海鮮、大阪市淀川区東三国4-9-5、東三国駅から徒歩約4分、月〜土12:00〜22:00 (ランチは12:00〜15:00、入店は21:00まで)、日曜・祝日休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー可、禁煙、2024年3月21日オープン。口コミ (2026年4〜10月): 小さな路地の中、日替わりの「Anono Gozen」1,650円 (刺身、焼き魚、から揚げ、だし巻き、手作りのおばんざい約10品、みそ汁、ごはん)、ランチは予約でいっぱいの日が多い、予約は電話で、開店前に並ぶなら全員そろって、1階はカウンター8席と4人テーブル、2階もある、夜は刺身の盛り合わせ (一切れずつ) と前菜9品で2,800円、貝の煮付け、自家製あんきもポン酢、さつまいもバター、ビール、ハイボール、日本酒、2人で昼から飲んで8,000円、常連が多い、テレビで紹介された。

osaka_fujiyama_yakiniku_juso.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Meat comes with a garlic-and-chili tare or salt, and the dipping sauce is miso-based (March 2026); cold noodles are on the menu.
osaka_fujiyama_yakiniku_juso.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku and horumon restaurant.
osaka_fujiyama_yakiniku_juso.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:00–21:00; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations strongly recommended, often full from 17:00; leave a voicemail and the shop calls back (2025–2026). Cash only (Tabelog). Five tables (March 2026); non-smoking (Tabelog). Long-established; moved to this address on the other side of Juso Station by July 2025 (July 2025).
osaka_fujiyama_yakiniku_juso.notes: [Yakiniku · Juso, an old-school horumon house with five tables] A long-running neighbourhood yakiniku near Juso, moved to this street with its old sign by 2025, five tables that are booked solid from 17:00 (2025–2026). The meat comes either in a garlic-and-chili tare or with salt; regulars say take the tare, with white rice, and dip in the miso sauce with a touch of sansho (March 2026). The horumon platter is ¥1,800, salted tongue ¥1,300, and the raw-cut omasum and heart are a highlight; most eat and drink well for under ¥5,000 (2025–2026). Book by leaving a voicemail. Cash only; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog. Reviewers: a long-established Juso yakiniku that moved to the other side of the station and kept its old sign (July 2025); welcomed a late guest with a smile (July 2025); reservations by voicemail (March 2026).

anecdotes.text: "It was fully booked from the opening at 5 PM, which shows its popularity." — August 2025.
"With only 5 table seats available, making a reservation is recommended." — March 2026, horumon platter A for JPY 1,800.
"The yakiniku sauce was different from other places—light yet rich and incredibly tasty." — December 2025.

osaka_robata_dokoro_isshin_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Yakitori comes with salt or a sweet-savoury sauce, and the menu has chicken nanban, fried fish, omurice and yakisoba.
osaka_robata_dokoro_isshin_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Mon–Fri and holidays 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–23:00 (food last order 22:15, drinks 22:30); Sat 17:00–23:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; book at weekends, as both counter and tatami fill by 18:00 (Tabelog; 2026). Cards, iD, QUICPay and PayPay accepted; a raw-cabbage appetiser is charged ¥380 (medium) or ¥250 (small) (Tabelog). 27 seats: about ten at the counter and a tatami area; smoking allowed (Tabelog; September 2026). English menu available (Tabelog).
osaka_robata_dokoro_isshin_higashimikuni.notes: [Yakitori · Higashi-Mikuni, chicken sashimi and gacha-yaki in a busy local] A lively, old-style yakitori house with a counter and tatami room two minutes from Higashi-Mikuni Station, packed by 18:00 at weekends (2026). It cooks Miyazaki Jitokko, Kawachi duck and Yamato chicken (Tabelog shop text): big skewers, a rare-seared breast that surprises, a seven-cut chicken sashimi with sesame oil and salt, and the house "gacha-yaki" of mixed cuts in a sweet-spicy sauce (2026). Weekday lunch is the ¥1,100 torijuu with free rice refills (September 2026). Smoking allowed; English menu. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog shop text: a chicken restaurant two minutes from Higashi-Mikuni Station using Miyazaki Jitokko, Osaka Kawachi duck and Nara Yamato chicken for yakitori, tataki and sashimi, with omurice, pasta and creative dishes too. Reviewers: a local, vintage feel and a long-time favourite of people who once worked nearby (2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Freshness of the chicken first (Tabelog shop text).

anecdotes.text: "The Gacha-yaki was exceptionally delicious. The sauce was so tasty that it made me crave rice, with a perfect sweet and spicy balance." — August 2026.
"I usually think of chicken breast as dry when cooked, but served rare, it's completely different." — September 2026.
"Comes with two small side dishes, and you can refill your rice and miso soup as much as you like." — September 2026, torijuu for JPY 1,100.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 炉端処 一心、焼き鳥、大阪市淀川区東三国5-7-3、東三国駅北口から西へ徒歩2分、月〜金・祝11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)、17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:15、ドリンク22:30)、土17:00〜23:00、日休み、予約可、カード・iD・QUICPay・PayPay 可、お通しの生キャベツは中380円・小250円、27席、座敷、喫煙可、英語のメニューあり。店の紹介: Miyazaki Jitokko、Kawachi の鴨、Yamato の鶏を使う鶏料理の店、焼き鳥、たたき、刺身、オムライスやパスタなども。口コミ (2026年2〜9月): 週末は予約を、カウンター約10席と座敷4〜5卓、大きな串、やげん軟骨、レアのむね、砂ずり、せせり、つくね、「Gacha-yaki」(せせりやハラミなどいろいろな部位をタレか塩で)、鶏刺し7種盛り (ごま油と塩で)、もも刺し、鶏そぼろと塩昆布のポテサラ、チキン南蛮、アジフライ、なすの鶏そぼろ、白いオムライス、鶏とかつお節のおにぎり、長芋焼き、焼きそば、ランチの鶏重1,100円 (炭火のももとむね、だし巻き、小鉢2品、ごはんとみそ汁おかわり自由)。

osaka_a_la_mode_osaka_soemoncho.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Macarons are usually made with almond flour, but the parfaits, cakes, fondant and cookies are not described.
osaka_a_la_mode_osaka_soemoncho.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. The sweets are cream, chocolate and cake based.
osaka_a_la_mode_osaka_soemoncho.hours_raw: Daily 15:00–24:00; may close early when sweets sell out; open year-round (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and recommended, also seat-only reservations (Tabelog; November 2025). One drink per person (November 2025). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 24 seats: counter, sofas, private rooms for 2–6 and a terrace; heated-tobacco smoking area (Tabelog). Orders by QR code (August and December 2025). Down the stairs to the basement of a Soemoncho building (August 2025, January 2026). Opened 16 July 2022 (Tabelog).
osaka_a_la_mode_osaka_soemoncho.notes: [Night café · Soemoncho, plated sweets and fan celebrations until midnight] A turquoise-and-pink basement café in the middle of Soemoncho's nightlife, open from 3 p.m. to midnight, where a female pastry chef's parfaits, Mont Blanc and fondant are served alongside a proper bar. It is a favourite for 'oshi-katsu', celebrating a favourite idol or character: book the plate course and your colour and message are drawn on the plate, or order a custom cake or a cookie tin. Order by QR code, one drink each. Seats are few, so book; one diner found service slow. Most guests are women, though there is shochu for anyone.

roles: Pastry chef (unnamed; a woman, per the Tabelog listing) and bar staff
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a night café five minutes from Namba Station, offering what it calls Japan's first "Midnight Tea" set until midnight; sweets handmade by a female pastry chef; terrace and private rooms; opened 16 July 2022. Instagram: @a.la.mode.osaka.
chef_bio.specialty: Plated parfaits and celebration plates; custom cakes.

anecdotes.text: "With this course, you can choose your favorite color and have your desired text written on the plate (with a character limit)." — August 2025, the oshi-katsu plate course.
"I made a reservation just for the seats, and it turned out that all three of the available seats were reserved." — November 2025.
"In addition to parfaits and a la mode desserts, there are also light snacks on the menu, as well as options for older gentlemen, like shochu with hot water." — January 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): a la mode osaka、カフェ・スイーツ・バー、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町4-5 B1F、なんば駅・日本橋駅から徒歩5分、毎日15:00〜24:00、スイーツが売り切れると早く閉めることも、年中無休、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、24席、2〜6名の個室、テラス、加熱式たばこの喫煙所、2022年7月16日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): 深夜0時までの夜カフェ、日本初という「Midnight Tea」、女性のパティシエの手作りのスイーツ、写真映えする店内、推し活向き。口コミ(2024年9月〜2026年2月): ネオンのサイン、ターコイズとピンクの店内、本格的なバー、プチマカロン、アイスのセイロンティー、フォンダンショコラのお祝いのプレート、予約制の推し活プレートのコース (好きな色と文字をプレートに)、9色のクッキー缶、オーダーケーキ、パフェ、いちごミルク、モンブラン、ガトーショコラ、焼酎のお湯割り、軽食、QR コードで注文、1ドリンク制、席は予約で埋まる、提供が遅いという声、客の多くは女性。

osaka_tamariba_pon_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The point is the sake; snacks are few, and bringing your own food is common.
osaka_tamariba_pon_namba.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Sake is the focus; snacks include clams steamed in sake and rolled omelette.
osaka_tamariba_pon_namba.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:30–23:30 (last order 23:00); closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private hire for 20 or more Sunday to Thursday, 30 or more Friday and Saturday (Tabelog). Pay the drinks plan when seated (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 56 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Bring your own food or order delivery; on weekdays takoyaki makers, hot-pot equipment and games can be borrowed; you may step out and come back (Tabelog; December 2025, July 2026). Opened 2 October 2017 (Tabelog).
osaka_tamariba_pon_namba.notes: [Sake bar · Namba, all the sake you can pour] A fourth-floor hideaway two minutes from Osaka-Namba where the fridges hold about 150 sakes from all over Japan and you pour your own. Plans start at ¥2,750 for 90 minutes, and an unlimited-time plan lets you stay all evening (listed at ¥3,000; a September 2025 diner paid ¥3,850 including beer and chūhai). The food menu is short, so do as the regulars do and bring your own dishes or order delivery; on weekdays you can even borrow a takoyaki maker or hot-pot set. One January 2026 diner found restocking slow and the snacks thin. Non-smoking; closed Mondays.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: self-serve all-you-can-drink of about 150 sakes from across the country, including rare limited editions; bring-your-own food and delivery welcome; on weekdays cooking equipment such as takoyaki makers and games to borrow; private hire; opened 2 October 2017.

anecdotes.text: "You can bring your own food, so it’s a good idea to either order delivery or pick up something from another restaurant before coming." — July 2026.
"I tried 21 different types of sake, but I drank so much that I couldn’t even remember which one I liked best." — December 2025.
"While the selection of sake is extensive, I felt that the quality wasn't quite up to par. It seems like it takes a long time for the sake to be replenished." — January 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 日本酒が永遠に飲める店 たまり場PON、居酒屋・日本酒バー・バル、大阪市中央区難波1-4-3 難波チャンプビル 4F、大阪難波駅から徒歩2分、火〜日17:30〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、月曜休み、予約可 (貸切は日〜木20名から、金土30名から)、席で先に料金を払う、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、56席、禁煙、2017年10月2日オープン、日本酒の90分飲み放題2,750円、時間無制限3,000円。店の紹介 (英訳): 全国の約150種の日本酒 (限定の珍しい酒も) をセルフで飲み放題、持ち込みや出前も可、平日はたこ焼き器などの調理器具やゲームの貸し出し。口コミ(2025年9月〜2026年7月): 時間無制限の飲み放題3,850円 (ビール、焼酎、ハイボール、チューハイも)、1杯600円の単品、酒蒸しのあさり、だし巻き、常連は料理を持ち込む、途中で出てまた戻れる、補充が遅い・つまみが少ないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-service rules explained by staff; no English menu evidence found.

osaka_ishinabe_inyon_dotonbori.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Hot pots finish with udon or a cheese pasta, and jeon and chijimi are on the menu.
osaka_ishinabe_inyon_dotonbori.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the broth is simmered from beef bones and chicken carcasses.
osaka_ishinabe_inyon_dotonbori.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Fri 17:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–23:00; last order 22:30; closed Tuesday unless a holiday (Tabelog; official site). One September 2026 diner found it open from 16:30. Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 35 seats at a counter and sunken tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog; official site; March 2026). English menu (official site). Interior renovated October 2022 (official site). Opened 12 May 2021 (Tabelog).
osaka_ishinabe_inyon_dotonbori.notes: [Korean · Dotonbori, nakkopse in a hot stone pot] A basement Korean restaurant just inside the Dotonbori arcade, whose broth, simmered for two days from beef bones and chicken, the shop traces to a grandmother's offal hot-pot shop by Nishikujo Station in 1945. Order the nakkopse: octopus, shrimp and plump offal under a heap of bean sprouts in a bubbling stone pot, spice level of your choice, then finish with udon or the house cheese pasta. Bulgogi hot pot and chijimi are also praised. Side dishes draw complaints: frozen yukhoe and dry bossam in March 2026, and side dishes that seemed frozen in October 2026, when one diner found a single woman from Myanmar running the room. Smoking allowed; English menu; closed Tuesdays.

roles: Owner (unnamed; signs the official site) and staff; one October 2026 diner found the shop run by a single woman from Myanmar
chef_bio.background: Official site (ishinabeinyon.com): a Korean stone-pot specialist in Dotonbori; the broth goes back to あたりや, an offal hot-pot shop by Nishikujo Station opened in 1945 by a grandmother in the shop's story, who cooked "food that is gentle on the body, delicious and gives strength"; beef bones, chicken carcasses and aromatic vegetables simmered over two days; renovated October 2022; English menu; smoking allowed. Tabelog: opened 12 May 2021; sister restaurant 石鍋KOH.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Gentle on the body, delicious, and gives you strength" (the grandmother's motto, official site).

anecdotes.text: "A rich and spicy broth made from simmering beef bones and chicken carcasses with plenty of vegetables for over 8 hours, perfected over two days." — April 2026, the stone-pot nakkopse.
"The yukhoe was clearly frozen, and the bossam was dry." — March 2026.
"The bulgogi was packed with meat, providing a satisfying sense of fullness!" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ishinabeinyon.com): 韓国肉料理・石鍋 イニョン 道頓堀店、牛骨・鶏ガラ・香味野菜を二日がかりで炊く出汁、昭和20年、西九条駅前で祖母が営んだホルモン鍋の店「あたりや」から80年、「身体にやさしく、美味しく、力がつく料理」、英語のメニュー、喫煙可能店、2022年10月全面改装、月水〜金17:00〜23:00・土日祝11:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、火曜定休。食べログ (店舗会員): 韓国料理・居酒屋・鍋、大阪市中央区道頓堀2-1-8 ゼルコバトレ B1F、なんば駅から徒歩2分、予約可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、35席、喫煙可、2021年5月12日オープン、姉妹店は石鍋KOH、名物の石鍋ナッコプセ (たこ、えび、国産のホルモン)、締めの濃厚なチーズのパスタ。口コミ(2026年3月〜10月): もやしの山の下にえびとたことホルモン、辛さを選べる (3が標準)、締めのうどん、和牛のプルコギ鍋、サムギョプサル、ユッケ、ポッサム、海鮮スンドゥブ、チヂミ、ジョン、チャプチェ、チゲ、ユッケが冷凍でポッサムがかたかったという声、副菜が冷凍のようだったという声、16時半から開いていた日も、ミャンマー出身の女性がひとりで切り盛りしていたという声。

osaka_buta_no_shippo_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Chicken nanban and other fried dishes are on the menu; the oden broth is chicken based.
osaka_buta_no_shippo_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken-broth oden, pork shabu-shabu and chicken dishes.
osaka_buta_no_shippo_namba.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–5:00 (last order 4:00); closed only at New Year (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 44 seats: counter, booths, a low-ceilinged loft, tatami and an 8-person semi-private room (Tabelog; December 2025). Smoking allowed; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Drinks are strong (March 2026).
osaka_buta_no_shippo_namba.notes: [Izakaya · Sennichimae, chicken-broth oden until 5 a.m.] A colourful Sennichimae izakaya open until 5 a.m., with counter, booths and a low loft upstairs. The house specialities are oden simmered in a white chicken-bone broth, a whole charcoal-grilled bone-in chicken thigh, and shabu-shabu of Agu pork from Ishigaki Island; the pork tsukune is the reviewers' pick. Portions run large, drinks run strong, and teas brewed in-house go into the shochu, including a corn-tea highball. Courses with two hours of drinks start at ¥3,800. Good for late groups; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: fresh chicken dishes and pork specialities a few steps from Namba Station, open until 5 a.m.; homemade chicken-broth oden, grilled chicken thigh, charcoal-grilled and shabu-shabu Agu pork from Ishigaki Island, tea-based shochu made with house tea leaves, fresh-fruit sours. A second shop, 豚のしっぽと鶏のとさか (27112749), is in shops.jsonl.
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken-broth oden; bone-in chicken thigh; Agu pork shabu-shabu.

anecdotes.text: "The pork tsukune is especially delicious, so be sure to order it!" — September 2026.
"I noticed that there was a wide variety of tea-based drinks, including a unique corn tea highball" — October 2025.
"However, the drinks were exceptionally strong, so be cautious when ordering plain sours." — March 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 豚のしっぽと鶏のとさか なんば店、居酒屋・鶏料理・豚しゃぶ、大阪市中央区千日前1-7-11 上方ビル 1F、日本橋駅から徒歩5分、なんば駅から7分、毎日17:00〜翌5:00 (L.O.4:00)、年末年始のみ休み、予約可、カード (VISA、Master)・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、44席 (カウンター、ボックス、ロフト、座敷、8名の半個室)、喫煙可、車いす可、骨つきもも焼きのコース2時間飲み放題つき3,800円。店の紹介 (英訳): 自家製の鶏の白湯のおでん、骨つきの鶏もも焼き、Ishigaki 島のアグー豚の炭火焼きとしゃぶしゃぶ、自家製の茶葉の茶割り、生の果物のサワー。口コミ(2025年10月〜2026年9月): 豚つくね、鶏刺しとたたき、大盛りでも同じ値段のチキン南蛮、豚レバーの焼き物、春菊のサラダ、ポテトサラダ、お通しの湯豆腐やあさりの酒蒸し、とうもろこし茶のハイボール、飲み物が濃い、ロフトは天井が低い、カラフルな店内。

osaka_sushi_labysse_four_seasons.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Edomae sushi brushed with soy sauce, a consommé instead of miso soup, and French sauces and desserts.
osaka_sushi_labysse_four_seasons.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi and French seafood course.
osaka_sushi_labysse_four_seasons.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 11:30–14:30 (last seating 13:30) and 17:30–21:00 (last seating 20:00); closed Wednesdays (Tabelog). Opened October 25, 2024 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: 14 at the counter and a private room for 6 (minimum spend ¥45,000 at lunch, ¥90,000 at dinner); non-smoking; children 6 and over can take the courses (Tabelog). Smart casual: no caps, T-shirts, shorts, tank tops or sandals, and no strong perfume (Tabelog). Paid parking shared with the condominium (July 2026).
osaka_sushi_labysse_four_seasons.notes: [Sushi · Nishi-Umeda, French sushi on the 37th floor] A twenty-seat counter on the 37th floor of the Four Seasons Hotel Osaka, opened in October 2024, where French appetizers and desserts devised under three-star chef Yannick Alléno frame Edomae sushi from head chef Itaru Yasuda, with apple-ginger gari and a consommé in place of miso soup. The view is the draw, and lunch costs about a third of dinner; holiday omakase run ¥35,000–65,000. Many guests are from overseas, and some nights a younger or non-Japanese chef serves. Diners love the fusion; one disliked a chef saucing nigiri by hand, others found the rice large or the counter tight. Smart casual; closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a blend of French cuisine and Edomae sushi by French chef Yannick Alléno, holder of 18 Michelin stars, and chef Itaru Yasuda, with over 30 years of experience; sake chosen by head sommelier Makoto Kido; private dining rooms with city views. Opened October 25, 2024 in the Four Seasons Hotel Osaka. The Yannick Alléno Group also runs L'Abysse in Paris, Monte-Carlo and Dubai (web search). Diners: some nights the head chef serves, other nights a younger or non-Japanese chef (2026).

anecdotes.text: "The gari (pickled ginger) was a delightful mix of apple and ginger." — June 2026.
"I was particularly impressed by the combination of the swordfish and sea urchin!" — May 2026.
"The view from the 37th floor is stunning!" — October 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: A hotel restaurant whose guests are mostly from overseas (June and October 2026); no English menu is listed on Tabelog.

osaka_ukai_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Recent courses ended with yakisoba or Neapolitan pasta and included a katsu sandwich (2026 reviews).
osaka_ukai_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of wagyu, abalone, tuna and foie gras; a diner noted few non-meat options (May 2026).
osaka_ukai_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 18:00–23:00; Sat 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays; may close for the chef's circumstances (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). Table charge ¥1,100 per person (Tabelog). Opened March 10, 2020 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 5 counter seats; private hire for 4–5; non-smoking; smart casual (Tabelog). Unsigned entrance in the basement of a building between Kamidori and Hondori (2025–2026 reviews). Tabelog Award Bronze 2025 and 2026; Innovative 100 in 2025.
osaka_ukai_kitashinchi.notes: [Innovative · Kitashinchi, a five-seat counter in flux] A five-seat counter behind an unsigned basement door in Kitashinchi, part of the group behind IAKU and Sichuan MITSUBACHI, with Tabelog Bronze awards for 2025 and 2026. The kitchen has changed hands more than once: diners in 2025–2026 met an owner-chef named Hattori, then a Chef Ueda, and from November 2026 the shop text announces a Japanese-based ten-dish course for ¥10,000 by Chef Kamegen under Hattori's supervision, plus a ¥33,000 Matsuba-crab course for private parties. Past highlights were Yamagata beef, abalone and tuna with karasumi; two May 2026 diners found a Neapolitan finish poor value. ¥1,100 table charge; reservation only.

roles: Supervisor and owner-chef Hattori (Tabelog; March 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): from November 2026 U.KAI becomes "Yūkai" dining led by Chef Kamegen, trained at a renowned Japanese restaurant, with a ten-dish seasonal course under the supervision of Hattori Yūkai; wines and sake chosen by a sommelier. Opened March 10, 2020. Reviews: a first visit "since Chef Hattori Yuka took over as the owner-chef" (March 2025); "the first time since Chef Ueda took over" (June 2026); "the chef had changed" (May 2026). An August 2026 diner calls Sichuan MITSUBACHI the Chinese branch of U-KAI.

anecdotes.text: "The abalone paired with a light and delicate broth was simply outstanding!" — April 2026.
"I was surprised that the final dish was Neapolitan pasta at this price point." — May 2026.
"The Yamagata beef steak is outstanding." — October 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Five-seat counter; staff explain each dish (2025). No English evidence found.

osaka_sushi_aoki_fukushima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sushi with soy sauce, simmered whelk and sweet-sauced eel.
osaka_sushi_aoki_fukushima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and shellfish sushi shop.
osaka_sushi_aoki_fukushima.hours_raw: Tue, Wed, Thu, Sat 17:30–23:00; Fri 17:30–22:00; closed Mondays and Sundays; hours may change (Tabelog). Cards: AMEX only; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter and two semi-private tables for 4; non-smoking (Tabelog). Walk-ins possible later in the evening (July 2026). Every dish and drink has a price on the menu (December 2025).
osaka_sushi_aoki_fukushima.notes: [Sushi · Fukushima, a Showa-era neighbourhood counter] A sixteen-seat neighbourhood sushi shop a quiet ten minutes north of JR Fukushima, run for about twenty years by Mr. Aoki and loved by locals more than Instagram. The menu prices everything, nigiri come two to a plate, about ¥330–660 a pair, so a full evening of sashimi, oyster vinegar, grilled fugu, ankimo and nigiri runs about ¥6,000–8,000, or ¥3,500 for a light one. Regulars praise the balance of rice and fish and the steady service; there are semi-private tables at the back. AMEX is the only card; closed Sundays and Mondays.

chef_bio.background: Reviews: "a long-standing establishment for about 20 years", rarely on social media (May 2026); "I had been looking forward to meeting Mr. Aoki" (March 2026); a Showa-era sushi restaurant (November 2025). The Tabelog listing is not shop-maintained.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal nigiri; à la carte sashimi.

anecdotes.text: "The menu features clear pricing for all dishes, sushi, and drinks, ensuring transparency." — December 2025.
"Since the nigiri comes in pairs, if you go with two people, you can each have one piece." — May 2026.
"I walked in around 9:00 PM without a reservation. Great value for the price." — July 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Local regulars; a priced menu helps ordering (December 2025). No English evidence found.

osaka_nitro_sonezaki.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Courses include homemade focaccia, pasta such as squid-ink tagliolini, fritters and zeppole.
osaka_nitro_sonezaki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses built on aged fish, sea urchin and seafood.
osaka_nitro_sonezaki.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 (last entry 13:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last entry 20:00); closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Five groups a day (Tabelog). Bookings need a reachable phone number; no cancellations by fax or voicemail (Tabelog). Opened October 12, 2018 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 16 seats: 6 at the counter, a table for 4 and a private room for 6; non-smoking (Tabelog). Children welcome with a reservation, kids' menu, strollers welcome (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog's Japanese field says 無し (none); its machine translation says a charge is added.
osaka_nitro_sonezaki.notes: [Italian · Umeda, Sonezaki, aged-fish Italian behind a black facade] A sixteen-seat creative Italian behind a black facade a short walk from Higashi-Umeda, open since 2018 and taking only five groups a day, which makes its private room popular for lunches and celebrations. The kitchen ages fish Japanese-style and serves it in Italian courses: striped-jack carpaccio with an apple-dill sauce, a cold squid-ink tagliolini with fritters, sea-urchin espuma, bread with rosemary oil from a dropper. Lunch courses are ¥5,800 and ¥7,800, dinner ¥12,000; wine pairings and good cocktails. Children welcome with a booking.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a hidden space behind a black exterior; a creative blend of Japanese and Italian cuisine featuring aged fish and seasonal ingredients, served on carefully chosen tableware; wine pairings; lunch as well; five groups a day. Opened October 12, 2018. A July 2026 diner heard of a sister café in Fukushima where the canelé is made.
chef_bio.philosophy: Ageing fish to bring out umami, applying Japanese technique to Italian cooking (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "It was my first time having a cold cream pasta, but the chill really enhanced the sauce, making it incredibly tasty." — August 2026.
"I had a refreshing experience using a small dropper to apply fragrant rosemary oil on the bread for the first time." — June 2026.
"The restaurant's specialty, dishes made with 'aged fish,' were served, and my satisfaction level was through the roof" — September 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Each dish explained in detail (June 2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_torico_meat_namba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: an all-you-can-eat Italian meat bar built on pizza, pasta, focaccia and fried dishes alongside the steaks (Tabelog menu; reviews).
osaka_torico_meat_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu and pizza meat bar; no vegan options are described.
osaka_torico_meat_namba.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–23:30 (last food order 22:30, drinks 23:00); closed New Year's Day (Tabelog). Reservations taken; popular at weekends, with a weekend surcharge (September 2026 review). ¥400 charge per person (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay; no e-money. 50 seats; private hire for 4–50 by phone (Tabelog). Third floor up outdoor stairs, no lift (2026 reviews). Orders by smartphone; the next order opens only when the last arrives (2026 reviews).
osaka_torico_meat_namba.notes: [Italian · Namba, wagyu-and-pizza all-you-can-eat] A dim third-floor meat bar up outdoor stairs by Nankai Namba, opened in September 2024, popular for girls' nights and birthdays, where all-you-can-eat-and-drink courses bring wagyu steaks, roast beef, pizza and pasta to order by phone. Diners in 2026 like the value, the strip-loin steak and the decorated birthday plates; others found the time limit short, the drinks watery, the pasta and pizza tough or the staff stiff. Order one round at a time: the next opens only when the last arrives.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, the house serves carefully selected Japanese black wagyu at an affordable price with Italian dishes of domestic wagyu and seasonal produce, and a buffet of creative dishes; opened 5 September 2024.

anecdotes.text: "I was truly surprised by how popular this place is among women!" — August 2026, girls' night out.
"While it was a luxurious all-you-can-eat experience, I was disappointed by the short time limit that didn’t allow for a leisurely meal." — September 2026.
"I ordered the Black Course, and the strip loin steak served first was the most delicious dish." — October 2026.

osaka_cabbage_yaki_namba.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–01:00 (official shop guide; Tabelog); hours may change. No reservations. Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). A standing stall; eat at the counter or take away (reviews).
osaka_cabbage_yaki_namba.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Nambanaka, ¥200 cabbage yaki street stall] A tiny standing stall across from the Swissotel by Nankai Namba, open from 10 AM to 1 AM, selling cabbage yaki — a thin, egg-topped cabbage pancake — for ¥200, still the price in 2026, plus takosen and a ¥400 okonomiyaki. Diners call it Osaka soul food for a snack or after drinks; one saw about twenty children eating there, another praises the hand-chopped cabbage. Cash only; eat on the spot or take away.

roles: Staff unnamed; a shop of the キャベ焼 group (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, the キャベ焼 group (president 山本昌美) has four shops: 難波, 鶴橋, ららぽーと甲子園 and 大阪ドームシティ, each with its own menu and toppings; the Namba shop opens 10:00–1:00. An October 2026 diner notes the cabbage is chopped by hand, adjusted to the day's cabbage.

anecdotes.text: "Amid rising prices, the JPY 200 Cabbage Yaki is a delightful snack for the everyday person." — June 2026.
"I realized it truly is soul food when I saw about 20 kids enjoying it!" — May 2026.
"At just JPY 200, it was an incredibly reasonable price, and the taste was quite good." — November 2026, third visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: キャベ焼グループ公式サイト: 社長 山本昌美、店舗案内は難波店 (浪速区難波中1-18-18、10:00〜1:00)、鶴橋店、ららぽーと甲子園店、大阪ドームシティ店、店ごとにオリジナルのメニューとトッピング、2020年4月7日に近大前店オープンのお知らせ。食べログ (英語版): キャベツ焼 難波店、南海なんば駅から徒歩1分、スイスホテルと南海本社の向かい、毎日10:00〜1:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、テイクアウト。口コミ (2026年3月〜11月): キャベツ焼200円、たこせん300円、お好み焼き400円、卵をのせて仕上げる、キャベツは手切り、立ち食い、子ども20人ほどが食べていた、大阪のソウルフード。

osaka_kappouan_egami_dojimahama.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Kaiseki dishes in dashi and soy, fried dishes such as a shrimp cutlet burger, red-vinegar sushi and a beef sukiyaki hotpot course.
osaka_kappouan_egami_dojimahama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood kaiseki, sushi and beef sukiyaki.
osaka_kappouan_egami_dojimahama.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 18:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); Sat 18:00–22:30 by reservation only; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). osaka_kappouan_egami_dojimahama.notes: [Kaiseki · 堂島浜, kappo and red-vinegar sushi] A sixteen-seat kappo restaurant tucked at the back of a Dojima-hama building, with a casual counter and a calm private room, serving seasonal kaiseki that ends in red-vinegar sushi from a chef who trained as a sushi craftsman. Courses run ¥13,200–15,400, including a beef sukiyaki course; the dishes are generous enough that one February 2026 diner left sushi behind. Its once-famous ¥1,200 lunch ended in August 2025. Saturdays by reservation only; smoking is allowed; VISA is the only card.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: kaiseki of seasonal fresh fish and vegetables, sushi by chefs experienced as sushi artisans, sake from various regions, counter and private rooms for anniversaries and business. The official site egami.cc lists the shop (read 2026-11-02).

anecdotes.text: "I first discovered this place when I started exploring popular lunch spots in Kitashinchi" — April 2025, a fifth visit; a later note says lunch ended on 8 August 2025.
"The counter area had the vibe of a casual izakaya, while the private rooms exuded the elegance of a fine dining restaurant." — February 2026.
"I especially loved the sweetfish small dish and the shrimp cutlet burger!" — June 2026.

osaka_kitashinchi_fuka_dojimahama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fillings of pork, beef, abalone, sardine and Kesennuma shark fin, with broths.
osaka_kitashinchi_fuka_dojimahama.hours_raw: Mon–Sat in two seatings, 17:30–19:30 and 20:00–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Reservation only, by the person dining; four or more and private hire by phone; children only if eating the course (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 8 seats at a curved counter; non-smoking (Tabelog; September 2026). No sign outside, only a rusted knife sculpture at the entrance (September 2026). Opened 8 May 2023 (Tabelog).
osaka_kitashinchi_fuka_dojimahama.notes: [Gyoza · 堂島浜, a gyoza omakase] An eight-seat curved counter in an unsigned basement in Dojima-hama, open since 2023 and on Tabelog's Dumplings 100 list in 2024, where the chef-owner turns gyoza into a tasting course. Wrappers are made with vegetables and seaweed and filled with Mangalica pork, Iga beef, wild abalone or Kesennuma shark fin, each dish explained on a card in an envelope; the menu has run to around 300 kinds. The omakase is ¥17,000, ¥27,000 with a sommelier's pairing, in two seatings; the second gets refills of pan-fried gyoza. Reservation only.

roles: Owner-chef (spelled "Yuuya Kusunoki" on Tabelog, "Yuya Kusunoki" in a review)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: chef Yuuya Kusunoki, "An Unyielding Explorer Living with Gyoza"; over a hundred varieties of gyoza; Mangalica pork, Iga beef, wild Ezo abalone, Kesennuma shark fin; opened 8 May 2023; Tabelog Dumplings 100 in 2024. A September 2026 diner writes that the owner, Yuya Kusunoki, carries on a family legacy, as the parents ran a Chinese restaurant; another counts around 300 kinds of gyoza created. Name given only in Latin letters in the sources read.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Capturing the essence of ingredients in the format of gyoza" (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "The owner greets guests personally, and each dish is accompanied by a detailed description in an envelope, explaining the journey of the gyoza and its unique flavors." — September 2026, the 8 PM seating.
"The signature dish, the shark fin from Kesennuma, was incredibly delicious" — October 2026, a fifth visit.
"It was my first visit in three years, and I noticed that a sommelier has joined to offer pairings." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 北新地 ふか、餃子・イノベーティブ、大阪市北区堂島浜1-3-22 ビル 堂島タウン B1F、大江橋駅から184m、月〜土の2部制 (17:30〜19:30、20:00〜22:00)、日・祝休み、予約のみ (来店する本人が予約)、4名以上と貸切は電話、子どもは大人と同じコースのみ、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、カウンター8席、禁煙、2023年5月8日オープン、食べログ 餃子 百名店 2024、皮と餡で餃子を組み立てなおすコース、野菜や海藻の皮、Mangalica の豚、Iga 牛のロース、天然の Ezo アワビ、いつも Kesennuma のフカヒレ、100種以上の餃子、餃子のおまかせコース17,000円、ワイン・日本酒・紹興酒のペアリングつき27,000円、2部は焼き餃子のおかわり、シェフは Yuuya Kusunoki。公式サイト fuka.works。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): 看板はなく入口に錆びたナイフのオブジェ、曲線のカウンター8席、店主があいさつし封筒に料理の説明、約300種の餃子、花オクラと Kada のアジやイワシの花餃子、Masutomi Shoten のしらすの丼餃子、水餃子と焼き餃子、松茸の餃子、ていねいなごはん、ソムリエのペアリング、店主の Yuya Kusunoki さんの両親は中華料理店、紹興酒1.5杯でコース20,700円。

cultural_comfort.note: Each dish explained on a card (September 2026); visitors from outside Osaka (October 2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_higyu_dojima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Yakiniku with sauces, a sirloin "yaki-shabu" over rice, yukhoe with egg yolk, garlic foil grill, cold noodles.
osaka_higyu_dojima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: black wagyu yakiniku and offal.
osaka_higyu_dojima.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 18:00–4:00 (last order 3:00); Sat 18:00–1:00 (last order 0:30); closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog's original text says none ("なし"). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), QUICPay; no QR (Tabelog). 18 seats: a counter of 8 and private rooms of up to 10; smoking allowed (Tabelog).
osaka_higyu_dojima.notes: [Yakiniku · Dojima, Daikokusen wagyu until 4:00] An eighteen-seat yakiniku room on a fifth floor at the east end of Kitashinchi's main street, on Tabelog's WEST 100 lists in 2025 and 2026, open until 4:00 on weekdays. It serves 'Daikokusen' black wagyu in thick cuts: the sirloin yaki-shabu over rice and the 'Sakeru Hire' fillet, cut at the grill by staff, are the showpieces, with chateaubriand, liver and a garlic foil grill. Courses are ¥8,800–13,200, or à la carte; diners find it pricey but worth it. Private rooms for business; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a new brand of black wagyu, "Daikoku Sen Gyuu", sommelier-chosen wines, rice supervised by the eighth-generation Gihei of Kyoto; Tabelog Yakiniku WEST 100 2025 and Grill WEST 100 2026. The Tabelog invoice number T7120001213193 is registered to 株式会社ＨＩＧＹＵ at the same building (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02). An October 2026 diner describes it as the high-end yakiniku of a group with sister restaurants such as "Satsuma".

anecdotes.text: "The Sakeru Filet was grilled by the staff, who cut it into perfect bite-sized pieces with a fork while it cooked on the grill." — August 2026.
"the sirloin shabu-shabu was fantastic—grill one side well and just sear the other side briefly, then place it on rice." — September 2026.
"If you can handle the smell, definitely order the garlic foil grilled dish." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 飛牛、焼肉・ホルモン、大阪市北区堂島1-1-20 パールプラザビル 5F、東西線 北新地駅から3〜5分、月〜金18:00〜4:00 (L.O.3:00)、土18:00〜1:00 (L.O.0:30)、日・祝休み、予約可、サービス料なし、カード・QUICPay 可、QR 不可、18席 (カウンター8、10名までの個室)、喫煙可、食べログ 焼肉 WEST 百名店 2025、Grill WEST 百名店 2026、ほかにない黒毛和牛「Daikokusen」、サーロインの焼きしゃぶ、目の前で切る Sakeru Hire、ソムリエが選ぶワイン、Kyoto の Gihei の八代目監修のごはん、特選黒毛和牛コース9品13,200円、盛り合わせのコース8,800円、和牛ヒレのしゃぶしゃぶ8,800円。インボイス登録は株式会社ＨＩＧＹＵ (同じビル)。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): シャトーブリアン、厚切りのタン、レバー、ハラミと特上ハラミ、ハラミの刺身、卵黄のユッケ、キムチとナムルの盛り合わせ、にんにくのホイル焼き、ハーフの冷麺、肉が大きい、北新地の大通りの東の端、値段は高めだが満足、Satsuma などの系列の高級店という声。

osaka_toributa_shoten_sassa_doyama.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Chicken sashimi, yakitori and pork skewers, chicken steak, fried dishes, kara-age with a sweet-spicy sauce, chicken kamameshi.
osaka_toributa_shoten_sassa_doyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken and pork dishes, even the starters.
osaka_toributa_shoten_sassa_doyama.hours_raw: Daily except Wednesday 18:00–1:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 24:00); open on Wednesdays that are holidays or the day before one (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; phone bookings may be seated at a table (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay (Tabelog). 17 seats: a counter of 7 and tables for 4, 4 and 2; smoking allowed (Tabelog).
osaka_toributa_shoten_sassa_doyama.notes: [Yakitori · Doyama, morning-fresh chicken] A seventeen-seat yakitori izakaya at the quiet far end of Higashi-dori, where the owner buys chicken fresh each morning for a sashimi platter, with Yoshiju pork skewers and dishes served on the house pottery. Order the chicken sashimi, the tsukune with egg yolk and a chicken rice bowl; even the starter is chicken. The ¥5,500 course includes two hours of drinks. Diners call it a calm hideaway near Umeda; one in September 2026 found service slow with only two staff. Closed Wednesdays; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: fresh chicken bought that morning and handled by the owner, rich "Yoshiju" pork and its tongue, tableware of "Imakiyaki" pottery (also "Imakatsu" on the listing), an adult hideaway in Higashi-Umeda, courses from ¥2,500. Reviews in 2025–2026 describe one or two staff on duty.

anecdotes.text: "What's even better is that the appetizer is chicken! It's so good!!" — January 2024.
"Tsukune: Crispy and fragrant on the outside, juicy with meat juices on the inside, wrapped in rich egg yolk—pure happiness!" — June 2026, a business traveller's second stop.

"The photo shows an assorted platter of chicken sashimi, but there were also skewers and pork steak, along with a satisfying chicken kamameshi and a delicious cream puff for dessert." — August 2026, the Adult Sassa course.
