osaka_sakana_nikomi_warayaki_tototo.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi and the straw-grilled bonito with salt are the plainest; the oden and stews are in soy-based dashi, and the courses include tempura and fu.
osaka_sakana_nikomi_warayaki_tototo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish izakaya; oden and stews in dashi, and the courses include duck, chicken and beef tendon.
osaka_sakana_nikomi_warayaki_tototo.hours_raw: Daily 16:30–23:30 (last food order 22:30); closing days vary (Tabelog). Reservations; omakase course ¥5,800 Tuesday–Friday only, premium omakase course ¥8,800, seafood hot-pot course with whole abalone ¥9,980, all-you-can-drink +¥2,800 (Tabelog). Dishes from the sister teppan restaurant in the building can be ordered (May 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 21 seats: a counter facing the straw grill and tables; non-smoking, with a smoking area inside (Tabelog; October 2026). English menu; takeaway (Tabelog). Opened 17 July 2025 (Tabelog); the listing announced an "8/8 new open".
osaka_sakana_nikomi_warayaki_tototo.notes: [Izakaya · Shinsaibashi-suji, Tototo's second shop of straw-grilled fish and stews] The second Tototo, opened in 2025 on the ground floor of the old Queens Court building between Namba and Shinsaibashi, a calm 21-seat room with a counter facing the straw grill. Most diners take the ¥8,800 omakase: a basket of small appetizers, thick-cut sashimi, bonito seared in a burst of straw flame, oden and slow stews such as bone-in chicken in white broth, then rice. The sister charcoal-and-teppan Tototo is next door in the same building, and its dishes can be ordered here. Diners in 2026 were consistently delighted with the food and service. Evenings only.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: seasonal fish prepared with straw grilling and charcoal grilling, slow-cooked stews and fresh sashimi by skilled chefs, with sake to match; opened 17 July 2025. Per 2026 reviews: the second location of Tototo, whose 魚と炭と鉄板と ととと (osaka_sakana_sumi_teppan_tototo) is in the same building, part of the same group.

anecdotes.text: "The sister restaurant 'Sakana to Sumi to Teppan to Tototo' in the same building is also delicious and popular! I had high expectations since they are part of the same group." — August 2026, the omakase premium course.
"The flames and smoke rising dramatically in front of us made our hearts race." — October 2026, warayaki of rare bonito belly.
"Additionally, you can also order from the menu of a nearby sister restaurant specializing in teppan-yaki." — May 2026, recommending the kamameshi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 魚と煮込みとわら焼きと ととと、居酒屋・海鮮・おでん、心斎橋筋2-3-2 クイーンズコートビル本館 101、Namba 駅から徒歩3分、Shinsaibashi 駅から5分、毎日16:30〜23:30 (L.O.料理22:30)、休みは変動、予約可、おまかせコース5,800円 (火〜金のみ)、おまかせプレミアムコース8,800円、アワビ丸ごとの海鮮鍋コース9,980円、飲み放題は+2,800円、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、21席、禁煙 (店内に喫煙所)、英語メニュー、テイクアウト、2025年7月17日オープン、旬の魚のわら焼きと炭火焼き、じっくり煮込んだ料理、刺身、日本酒。口コミ(2026年5月〜10月): ととと の2号店、同じビルに姉妹店、鰹のわら焼きを塩で、本マグロ、カンパチ、モンゴウイカ、みかん鯛、信州サーモン、大根の柚子味噌、厚揚げ、牛すじ、骨付き鶏の白湯煮、丸ごとトマトの出汁、とろゆば、釜飯、いくらご飯。

osaka_takohachi_dotonbori_sohonten.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: takoyaki, akashiyaki, okonomiyaki and yakisoba are wheat batter or noodles cooked on shared griddles.
osaka_takohachi_dotonbori_sohonten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the takoyaki batter is made with dashi (Tabelog) and holds octopus.
osaka_takohachi_dotonbori_sohonten.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–22:30 (last order 21:30) (Tabelog). Takeaway takoyaki ordered and paid at the front, with sauce, mayonnaise and Akashi-style dashi at the first-floor counter (October 2026). Reservations recommended for the upper floors (Tabelog; October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and QR including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 57 seats: a standing counter on the first floor, a counter on the second and tables on the third, up three flights of stairs (Tabelog; September 2026); non-smoking; free Wi-Fi and outlets; children welcome (Tabelog).
osaka_takohachi_dotonbori_sohonten.notes: [Takoyaki · Dotonbori, the 1979 Tako Hachi main shop] The main shop of Tako Hachi, making takoyaki in Osaka since 1979, on the Dotonbori strip: grab six hot ones from the first-floor stand, or climb to the counter and table floors for okonomiyaki, yakisoba, akashiyaki in broth and teppanyaki sets. The batter is built on dashi, and some find they need little sauce. Diners in 2026 call it a favourite, better than the big chains; the upper floors fill up, so book, and it is up three flights of stairs. Open daily 10:00–22:30.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: Tako Hachi, cherished in Osaka since 1979 (the header says 1978); takoyaki made with a special dashi, large octopus, tenkasu, ginger and green onion; over 90 menu items; three floors of seating. The official site lists the Dotonbori main shop and notes an appearance at a Japanese-artisan event in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
chef_bio.philosophy: A flavour loved in Osaka for decades (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "The takoyaki is fluffy and creamy, and the batter infused with dashi is truly delicious!" — September 2026.
"I made a reservation and was guided to the upper seating area, which required climbing three flights of stairs." — September 2026.
"6 pieces for JPY 650 … It was even tastier than the famous chain takoyaki shops." — October 2026, a Dotonbori takoyaki comparison.

osaka_kitaro_zushi_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi is the place to start; sushi comes with soy sauce, and fried dishes and shrimp toast contain wheat. The shop asks guests to note allergies when booking (Tabelog).
osaka_kitaro_zushi_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi and seafood restaurant; a few vegetable rolls such as kanpyo and yam-burdock (September 2026).
osaka_kitaro_zushi_namba.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–02:00 (last orders 01:00; fried food to midnight); closed 31 December, 1 January and company holidays; may close early in bad weather (Tabelog). Reservations; note allergies or dislikes when booking; two hours when busy (Tabelog). Prices on the menu exclude tax (Tabelog). No desserts; bring your own cake, uncut, with notice (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 55 seats: a counter of 19 on the first floor and horigotatsu seats, a banquet hall and a private room for 10 upstairs; non-smoking, ashtray by the exit (Tabelog; June 2026).
osaka_kitaro_zushi_namba.notes: [Sushi · Ura Namba, cheap sushi in a townhouse until 2 am] A busy Ura Namba sushi bar in a renovated townhouse, counter downstairs and horigotatsu rooms up, serving two-piece plates from ¥280 and drinks from ¥550 until 2:00. The pieces are small, so order widely: negitoro, yellowtail, uni, eel with cucumber, then à la carte shrimp toast, grilled milt and seasonal oysters. Diners in 2026 praise the value, the speed and the late hours; some popular items sell out early. Part of the small Kitaro Zushi group.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: over 10 years in Ura Namba; sushi from ¥280 and drinks from ¥550; fish from the Osaka central market and local markets; a stylish sushi bar in a renovated traditional house; a sister robata restaurant. A June 2026 diner heard the group is opening in Thailand; job listings name Ura Namba, Ohatsu Tenjin, a Shinsaibashi sushi-and-robata shop and a Toganocho kakuuchi.

anecdotes.text: "After enjoying a delicious meal, I strolled around Dotonbori and headed to Kitaro Zushi Namba, just like always." — October 2026, a tenth visit, for negitoro.
"While many places close around 11 PM, I was very grateful that this restaurant is open until 2 AM." — October 2026.
"Although it was early, I was disappointed to find some items were sold out due to the restaurant's popularity" — October 2026.

osaka_musi_vege_cafe_namba_city.vegan_detail: Ask. Every set comes with a plate of steamed vegetables and multigrain rice, but the mains are chicken, pork or shrimp and the soup is soy-milk miso, which may use dashi.

No reservations (Tabelog); a short wait at busy times (September–October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, iD, QUICPay and QR (Tabelog). 68 seats with sofas and divided tables, easy for solo diners; non-smoking; takeaway (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened 14 April 2021 (Tabelog).
osaka_musi_vege_cafe_namba_city.notes: [Café · Namba City, steamed-vegetable set meals] A roomy café-restaurant on the ground floor of Namba City, one of a few musi-vege branches, where every set comes with a big plate of steamed vegetables, multigrain rice and a soy-milk miso soup; pick one or two mains such as creamy shrimp mayo, yangnyeom chicken or black-vinegar chicken (about ¥1,500 for two). It stays open from 11:00 to 22:00 without a break, and the divided tables suit solo diners. Regulars return for the vegetables and the shrimp mayo; some found the side dishes ordinary, the pork a little tough or a sofa grubby.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café specialising in vegetable dishes in the Namba City main building, opened 14 April 2021. Other musi-vege+cafe branches are in Umeda (Diamor Osaka), Sakai Takashimaya and LaLaport Sakai; a September 2026 diner found the quality consistent across branches.

anecdotes.text: "As always, their steamed vegetables and soy milk soup are delicious and my favorites!" — October 2026, shrimp mayo chili and yangnyeom chicken ¥1,518.
"I appreciate that they are open continuously for both lunch and dinner, making it convenient to visit even during odd hours." — September 2026.
"However, the flavors of the side dishes were all quite ordinary." — October 2026, a third visit for the shrimp mayo.

osaka_barkt_holiday_inn_namba.notes: [Italian · Soemoncho, hotel restaurant with a terrace] The plant-filled ground-floor Italian of the Holiday Inn Osaka Namba, with sofas, semi-private couple seats and a terrace, popular for anniversaries. At lunch fresh pasta or pizza with salad is about ¥1,500; at dinner the anniversary course ends with a sparkler cake. Order the Genovese with wild shrimp. Smoking only on the terrace.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing and ikyu: the restaurant and bar of Holiday Inn Osaka Namba by IHG. A September 2026 reviewer chatted with a bartender from Nepal.

anecdotes.text: "I learned that one of the staff members was from Nepal and doesn't drink alcohol at all, but had worked hard to learn everything." — September 2026, at the counter.
"The noodles were chewy and delicious, but honestly, I felt there was quite a lack of sauce." — August 2026, at lunch.

Reservations recommended (August 2026); one drink and one food item per person; two-hour limit when busy; 15 minutes late cancels (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), transport IC and other e-money, QR payment (Tabelog). 45 seats (5 counter, 20 table, 20 tatami with sunken seating); non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children and strollers welcome with kids' chairs (Tabelog). osaka_takoyaki_lab_nishishinsaibashi.notes: [Takoyaki · Nishi-Shinsaibashi, grill your own] A fourth-floor izakaya where each table has a takoyaki plate and you pour, fill and turn your own, with staff to coach you. Pick fillings from 21 toppings or try the rainbow, matcha or squid-ink "magma" takoyaki; a 10-piece custom set is ¥990, and the all-you-can-eat-and-drink course is ¥4,500. English menus and staff; tatami seats suit families. Book: it fills, with about half the guests from overseas (June 2026).

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing and PR Times: run by 株式会社place・to・connect; a Tripadvisor Travelers' Choice award winner (PR Times, search result). A December 2025 reviewer notes it sits on the 4th floor above a long-established takoyaki shop.

anecdotes.text: "Even if you don't know how to cook takoyaki, the staff will kindly guide you, so you can feel at ease!" — December 2025.
"During my visit, the restaurant was fully booked, with about half of the customers being international visitors." — June 2026, a reviewer who found the rainbow takoyaki expensive.
"Even my elementary school child enjoyed making it." — September 2026.

osaka_tsuboru_curry_nabe_shinsaibashi.notes: [Curry hot pot · Shinsaibashi, 24-spice broth] A small third-floor shop off Shinsaibashi-suji serving a cabbage-heavy hot pot in a medicinal-style curry broth of 24 spices, with meat and add-ons like oysters or lamb, finished with udon, ramen or a charred cheese risotto. Courses with drinks are good value; the manager keeps the room lively (October 2026). Smoking is allowed, and a ¥300 seat charge applies to overseas guests only.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): a medicinal curry hot pot of 24 spices. Per tabiiro (search result): run by a woman owner from Hokkaido (not named). A May 2026 reviewer says some of the spices were featured on the TV show "Reiwa no Tora".

anecdotes.text: "The manager, who is very charming, truly knows how to create a great atmosphere." — October 2026.

osaka_okonomi_teppan_don_namba.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Namba, all-day teppan by the station] A two-floor okonomiyaki and teppan izakaya above the street between 551 Horai and Bic Camera, open from 11:00. The kitchen cooks your okonomiyaki and finishes it on your table grill; try the DON Special, the torched negi-pork or a cheese okonomiyaki, with horumon yakisoba. Reviewers find it calmer and better value than the tourist spots nearby, and the owner speaks English. Closed Mondays and Tuesdays.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a long-running owner-led shop (owner not named) — a November 2025 regular has visited since it opened and saw the owner speak English with overseas guests; an August 2026 reviewer describes the older owner's attentive service.

anecdotes.text: "Unlike other places bustling with foreign tourists, this restaurant had a lot of Japanese customers. As a result, the prices were reasonable, and the taste was delicious." — August 2025.
"Recently, it seems there are many foreign customers, and the owner was communicating in English." — November 2025, a regular since opening.
"The batter was fluffy and delicious, but there wasn't much filling. The staff came to turn off the grill quite early" — February 2025.

osaka_nikuya_kushihachi_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef yakiniku and shabu-shabu house; raw-egg rice.
osaka_nikuya_kushihachi_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–22:30 (last order 21:45); Sat and holidays 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:15); closed Sunday and one irregular day a month; may close early on holidays; check for New Year and Obon (Tabelog). osaka_nikuya_kushihachi_nishinakajima.notes: [Yakiniku · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, a 40-year house of hand-cut beef and private rooms] A 100-seat yakiniku and shabu-shabu house a minute from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, open for about 40 years in a brick-fronted building with sunken-kotatsu private rooms upstairs. Beef comes in whole blocks and is cut by hand, and the shop picks top-grade female cattle for taste, not brand name. First-timers are steered to the omakase course, from heart sashimi and yukhoe to thick tongue and chateaubriand; regulars rate the harami highest (2026). Courses can run slowly. Smoking at the table is allowed. Open to 22:30; closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop site (so-ya.co.jp, read 2026-11-02): "肉家くしはち" has been loved by the neighbourhood for about 40 years; meat chosen by experienced eyes, bought in blocks and hand-cut in the shop; "What matters is not the brand but the taste": only female cattle judged top grade; wagyu shabu-shabu a signature; private rooms, tables and counter for dates, business and banquets; the site has English and Chinese pages. Per reviews: "the owner happened to be there and grilled for us" (April 2026); a diner who first came decades earlier returned after more than 30 years (July 2026); a Hot Pepper reviewer has come for about 40 years (May 2026, web search); courses arrived "every 10 to 15 minutes" for one diner (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "What matters is not the brand but the taste" (shop site, translated).

anecdotes.text: "The outside skirt is particularly exceptional, with a perfect balance of tenderness and flavor." — April 2026, a fifth visit.
"Even though it was omakase, [the staff] listened to all my preferences, accommodating requests." — July 2025, wedding anniversary.
"Back in the day, we would always finish our meal with the Kushihachi Nabe, a hot pot filled with udon." — July 2026, a first visit in over 30 years.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 店のサイト (so-ya.co.jp): 西中島南方の焼肉・しゃぶしゃぶ専門店「肉家くしはち」、約40年、熟練の目利きで選ぶ最高級の肉をブロックで仕入れて店内で手切り、大切なのはブランドではなく味、最上級と判断した雌牛のみを全国から、看板のしゃぶしゃぶ、予約すればしゃぶしゃぶと焼肉の両方のコース、初めてならおまかせコース、個室・テーブル・カウンター、英語と中国語のページ。食べログ: 肉家 串八 西中島本店、焼肉・しゃぶしゃぶ・ステーキ、大阪市淀川区西中島3-21-4、西中島南方駅1番出口から徒歩1分、月〜金17:00〜22:30 (L.O.21:45)、土・祝17:00〜22:00、日曜と月1回不定休、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、お通し380円、100席 (カウンター5、掘りごたつ93)、個室、喫煙可。口コミ (2020年〜2026年9月): おまかせコース、ユッケ、ハツ刺し、センマイ刺し、厚切りタン、シャトーブリアン、ヒレ、ロース、ハラミ、リブロース、カルビ、ホルモン、冷麺、平日の飲み放題つきコース8,000円、厚切り塩タン、上ハラミ、イチボ、tsurami、レバー、タン刺し、卵かけごはん、2階の掘りごたつの個室、店主が焼いてくれた日も、コースの提供が遅いという声。

osaka_taishu_bistro_galetto_nishinakajim.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat bistro of wagyu, duck, cured meats and seafood.
osaka_taishu_bistro_galetto_nishinakajim.hours_raw: Mon–Wed, Fri, Sat and holidays (and the days before and after) 18:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); Thursday also lunch 12:00–14:00 (Tabelog). The listing also says "Closed on Sundays" while showing Sunday hours; Sunday is left off here. Reservations accepted; call even if online booking is full (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 90 seats: 40 in the restaurant and a banquet room for 50 next door; private hire for 20 to over 50 (Tabelog). Non-smoking, ashtray at the entrance (Tabelog).
osaka_taishu_bistro_galetto_nishinakajim.notes: [Bistro · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, the 匠 group’s wagyu bistro with wine that never stops] A 40-seat meat bistro, plus a 50-seat party room, north-west of Nishinakajima-Minamigata, run by the 匠 group and once called 大衆ビストロ 匠. Courses with all-you-can-drink start at ¥4,000, and the ¥5,000 plan has no time limit on about fifteen wines (2026). Dishes lean on the group’s Oita wagyu: carpaccio torched at the table, wagyu and sea urchin sushi, steak, with mussels and risotto between. Lively and good for groups; book at weekends. Open 18:00–23:00, lunch on Thursdays.

roles: Kitchen and floor staff of the 匠 group (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: bistro, Italian, meat bar; formerly 大衆ビストロ 匠 (Tabelog page history). Per reviews: "The restaurant used to be called Takumi, but it has changed its name" (October 2025); "being part of the Takumi group, the quality of the meat was exceptional" (July 2026); a diner who came when it first opened returned after 8 years (February 2026); a last-minute change in party size was accommodated (November 2025); one diner found the food unremarkable for the price but the drinks good value (December 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu bistro courses with unlimited-time wine.

anecdotes.text: "The JPY 5000 course included unlimited wine (until closing), which seemed unbelievable, but it was true." — July 2026.
"The Carpaccio, which is seared right in front of you, is both impactful and enjoyable." — November 2025.
"This restaurant uses Oita Wagyu, which is incredibly tender and delicious. The meat sushi is always melt-in-your-mouth." — December 2025.

osaka_hime_kokyo_aji_no_tabi_nishinakaji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fried chicken, fish and dashi throughout.

Reservations accepted; the ¥495 appetiser is included for course bookings (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 70 seats at tables; private hire for groups; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Rice and miso soup refills at lunch (2026).
osaka_hime_kokyo_aji_no_tabi_nishinakaji.notes: [Izakaya · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, Ehime cooking and giant Imabari fried chicken] A 70-seat Ehime restaurant five minutes west of Nishinakajima-Minamigata, the first of three 媛 shops nearby. The star is senzanki, Imabari’s fried chicken in huge thigh pieces; at lunch a five-piece set is about ¥950–990, or try the Nanyo tai-meshi, raw sea bream and egg over rice with dashi (2026). At night jakoten comes hot as the appetiser, highballs drop to ¥299 with an order of senzanki, and all-you-can-drink needs no course. Service can be brisk. Lunch and dinner; to 23:00, Fridays to midnight; closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: izakaya, regional cuisine and kara-age; particular about fish. Per reviews: "Hime has three locations near Nishinakajima: this one, Hime Imabari Yakitori no Tabi, and Hime 3. All of them are incredibly popular and often have long lines" (October 2026); "According to the staff, this is the first branch, while the one behind is the second" (July 2026); "This restaurant has many repeat customers" (October 2026); a regular on the fourteenth visit notes the menu keeps changing (September 2026); two diners found the service lacking (July and August 2026).

anecdotes.text: "The dish features a generous serving of sea bream soaked in broth, poured over rice topped with a raw egg." — September 2026, Nanyo tai-meshi set ¥990.
"The appetizer, Jako Ten, was served piping hot and freshly fried!" — July 2026.
"When you order the senzanki, you can enjoy highballs and chuhai for just JPY 299." — July 2026.

osaka_sakanaya_stand_fuji_shin_osaka.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi comes with soy sauce, and there are fried shrimp, tempura and other fried dishes.

osaka_sakanaya_stand_fuji_shin_osaka.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–23:00; open all year (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); expect a wait of 10–30 minutes in the evening, less at lunch (September–October 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (incl. Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted (Tabelog; September 2026). 50 seats: 34 at a long counter and four tables for four; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Lunch items sell out by about 13:30 (September 2026). Opened 30 March 2016 (Tabelog).
osaka_sakanaya_stand_fuji_shin_osaka.notes: [Izakaya · Shin-Osaka Station, cheap, good fish at the subway gate] A long-counter fish izakaya inside the station by the Midosuji north gate, run by a fishmonger who buys each morning, and busy from lunch to 23:00 with people waiting for trains (2026). Start with the ¥980 assorted fish platter or the katsuo sashimi, add a juicy dashimaki and salt-grilled collar, and finish with the Sakanaya Don, with cheap sake throughout (2026). Lunch is a ¥1,000 sashimi and grilled-fish set with free large rice (September 2026). Expect a 10–30 minute wait in the evening; no bookings. Open every day.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog shop text: a fish restaurant supplied directly by a fishery; the fishmonger owner buys fresh fish each morning, and skilled cooks make dashi from bonito and kombu, peel and devein shrimp, and keep to the basics; "stand" refers to standing-bar prices, though everyone sits. Opened 30 March 2016 (Tabelog). An October 2026 diner says the brand has several shops around Osaka; another mentions the Tennoji shop (September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Plenty of good fish at standing-bar prices (Tabelog shop text).

anecdotes.text: "The freshly made dashi-maki (Japanese omelette) was incredibly fluffy, and when cut, the broth oozed out, making it absolutely delicious." — October 2026.
"I ordered the sashimi and grilled mackerel set meal for JPY 1,000. While rice is free up to a large size, I opted for a medium size." — September 2026.
"The dish I highly recommend here is the Sakanaya Don. After enjoying the fish, this is a must-try to wrap up your meal." — September 2026.

Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 36 seats on Tabelog, 32 on the shop site, counter and tables; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome (Tabelog; shop site). No grills at the table: the meat arrives sizzling on a stone or iron plate (2026). Takeout yakiniku bento (shop site). Opened 10 January 2020 (Tabelog).
osaka_osaka_yakiniku_matsuya_shin_osaka.notes: [Yakiniku · Shin-Osaka Station, sizzling harami before the Shinkansen] A compact yakiniku counter in Alde Shin-Osaka, one floor below the Shinkansen gates, where the meat comes to you sizzling on a stone plate instead of a grill (2026). Reviewers say this is the house that coined the name "harami": the thick, tender original harami in a sweet, light sauce, with free rice refills at lunch, is the order (2026). Lunch runs ¥1,280–1,628 until 17:00; the bento travels well (2026; shop site). Open 10:00 to 22:00 every day.

chef_bio.background: Shop site (Matsuya Co.): the brand's only shop, inside Shin-Osaka Station, sending Matsuya's Osaka yakiniku to visitors from all over Japan; the stone plate makes the meat especially fragrant and tender. Opened 10 January 2020 (Tabelog). Reviewers: "This is the birthplace of the Outside Skirt, and the name was coined by this establishment" (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Stone-plate cooking for fragrance and tenderness (shop site).

anecdotes.text: "This place is said to be the first to sell the thin part of the cow's diaphragm known as 'Harami.'" — October 2026, original harami and Shin-Osaka horumon.
"The signature dish, 'Original Outside Skirt,' is thickly sliced and juicy!" — September 2026, harami and horumon lunch for JPY 1,280 plus tax.
"The outside skirt was thick, tender, and juicy, and the marinade was well-balanced without being overly sweet." — October 2026, harami 180 g.

osaka_daiyouken_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: ramen, gyoza, kara-age and wok dishes with soy-based sauces.
osaka_daiyouken_higashimikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: omurice with chicken rice and pork, chicken-broth ramen, gyoza.
osaka_daiyouken_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 16:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; cash only (Tabelog). 22 seats: 5 at the counter and four tables for four; non-smoking; children welcome; takeout (Tabelog). A short line at weekday noon (2026). One September 2026 diner found the room tired and the restroom a Japanese-style squat toilet, hard for anyone with limited mobility.
osaka_daiyouken_higashimikuni.notes: [Chinese · Higashimikuni, the local diner everyone visits for omurice] A busy, old-style Japanese-Chinese diner near Higashi-Mikuni Station, where nearly every table orders the omurice: ketchup chicken rice fried in a wok and wrapped in a thin omelette, ¥780 with egg soup, or ¥1,120 with a half ramen (October 2026). Add gyoza or the big sweet-and-sour meatballs, and a beer; regulars praise the little extras, from raisin macaroni salad to three pickles (October 2026). Expect a short line at noon. Cash only; closed Wednesday; open to 23:00.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog. Reviewers: a long-standing local Japanese-Chinese diner (October 2026); a busy room of solo diners, families and local regulars (September 2026); prices up since 2023 (October 2026).

anecdotes.text: "However, the Omurice is quite popular, with nearly half the customers ordering it." — October 2026, omurice and half ramen for JPY 1,120.
"This classic Omurice features fragrant chicken rice stir-fried in a Chinese wok, wrapped in a perfectly cooked thin omelet." — October 2026.
"I love the little touches like the salad with kaiware (daikon sprouts), macaroni salad with raisins (surprising!), and purple onions." — October 2026, kara-age set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 大養軒、中華料理・オムライス・餃子、大阪市淀川区東三国4-12-3、東三国駅から徒歩約7分、月・火・木〜日11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)、16:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、水曜休み、予約不可、現金のみ、22席 (カウンター5、4人テーブル4)、禁煙、子ども可、テイクアウト、となりにコインパーキング。口コミ (2026年4〜10月): 町の中華、半分くらいの客がオムライス、中華鍋で炒めたケチャップのチキンライスに豚肉、薄焼き卵、卵スープつき780円、大盛り180円、大盛り960円、オムライスと半ラーメン (あっさり塩気のある鶏ガラ) 1,120円、餃子は8個、大きな肉団子の甘酢あん、から揚げ定食、レバニラ炒め、冷麺、ちゃんぽん、カツ丼、味噌ラーメン、焼肉弁当、かいわれのサラダ、レーズン入りのマカロニサラダ、漬物3種、スープ、生ビールと餃子とオムライスで1,800円、昼は少し並ぶ、店とトイレが古く和式という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Plastic food samples in the window (October 2026); cash only. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated October 2026.

osaka_tabenoko_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Small plates include aji fry, spring rolls, a low-temperature pork cutlet, and ramen or kasu udon to finish.
osaka_tabenoko_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, meat and pork dishes; a grilled Shimonita leek and snap peas are on the menu.
osaka_tabenoko_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri, holidays and days before and after holidays 18:00–2:00 (last order 1:30); Sat 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Sundays (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY; no e-money (Tabelog). 20 seats; private hire up to 20; smoking allowed (Tabelog). The entrance is hard to find (October 2026).
osaka_tabenoko_kitashinchi.notes: [Izakaya · Kitashinchi, small plates until 2 am] A twenty-seat izakaya up a hard-to-find stair in Kitashinchi whose name says it: eat everything, nothing left over. Every dish comes in a one-person portion from about ¥300, so you can work through thirty-odd choices, thick aji fry, rare low-temperature pork cutlet, grilled tuna cheek, water dumplings, and finish with shijimi salt ramen or a secret kasu udon. Courses with all-you-can-drink run about ¥5,500–10,000. Regulars love the variety and the late hours; one first-timer found the cooking homely and the clams salty. Smoking allowed; open until 2 am on weekdays.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): only truly delicious dishes in small plates, tailored for each person, from drinking snacks to a closing ramen; a rare low-temperature tonkatsu of Ebisu mochi pork; a cozy space for dates and parties, 2 minutes from Kitashinchi Station. A December 2025 diner reads the name as the concept of finishing every dish.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Please enjoy so that there is no leftover food" (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "They're open until 2 AM, so it's perfect for grabbing a late-night ramen after drinks!" — June 2026.
"For the finale, I decided on the shijimi clam ramen with salt, which came topped with both pork and chicken chashu." — March 2026.
"the overall presentation and seasoning felt more home-cooked than restaurant-quality." — February 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Small plates suit solo diners (December 2025). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_tetsutarou_nakazakicho.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu includes tempura (lunch had an all-you-can-eat tempura deal), tuna katsu, gyoza and dashi-based dishes.
osaka_tetsutarou_nakazakicho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya; a ¥100 lotus-root kinpira and fried eggplant appear on the menu.
osaka_tetsutarou_nakazakicho.hours_raw: Dinner Mon and Wed–Fri 17:00–23:30, Sat 14:00–23:30, Sun 14:00–22:30 (last order 30 minutes before); lunch Wed–Sun 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) as the sister brand Kaisen Shokudo Haruko in the same premises; closed Tuesdays (open Tuesdays in December, without lunch); closing may run later (Tabelog). Groups of 10 or more by phone (Tabelog). Appetizer chosen by the guest, ¥400 (June 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay, PayPay (Tabelog). 111 seats: 9 at the counter, 52 at tables and a 50-seat tatami room with partitions; no smoking at lunch, smoking in the tatami and horigotatsu areas at dinner; wheelchair accessible; projector and microphone (Tabelog). QR-code ordering; a free first drink for LINE sign-up (June 2026).
osaka_tetsutarou_nakazakicho.notes: [Izakaya · Nakazakicho, a 111-seat seafood party house under the tracks] A huge, lively seafood izakaya under the JR tracks near Nakazakicho, built for parties of ten to a hundred, with a 50-seat tatami room and a microphone. Market fish arrives each morning: thick sashimi, tuna scraped from the bone with a spoon, a salmon-roe bowl heaped to a shout, tempura with assorted salts, and local sake by the tasting set; since the Expo it has added dishes from other countries. Party courses with drinks are about ¥5,000–6,000, and lunch, under the name Kaisen Shokudo Haruko, brings a ¥950 thick-sashimi set. Smoking at dinner in the tatami area; closed Tuesdays.

roles: The company president, who poses for photos with guests (March 2026)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): Umeda's largest seafood banquet izakaya, 111 seats; fresh seafood and local sake; groups of 10 or more; a room for up to 50 with large monitors and microphones; lunch run as the sister brand Kaisen Shokudo Haruko with the same ingredients and chefs; the omakase course is left to head chef Gan. The official site lists this Umeda-Nakazakicho shop.

anecdotes.text: "There was a menu item that allowed us to take a photo with the president" — March 2026.
"I went for the Thick Sliced Sashimi Assorted Platter Set Meal… JPY 950." — May 2026, at the lunch shop Haruko.
"At Tetsutarou, I tried Paparazzina, Zapiekanka, and Tuna Shkmeruli." — October 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: QR-code ordering; group-friendly (2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing and official site; reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_seafood_izakaya_ikou.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi and simmered fish with soy-based seasoning, tempura, and dashi-cooked kamameshi.
osaka_seafood_izakaya_ikou.hours_raw: Sun–Thu, holidays and days after holidays 17:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00); Fri, Sat and days before holidays 17:00–24:00 (food last order 23:00) (Tabelog). No closing days; renewal opening January 1, 2026; no takeout (April 2026). Appetizer ¥500, not with courses; private room ¥2,200 per group (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 16 seats: 10 at the counter and a private room for 4–6 (from 3 people); heated tobacco only (Tabelog). Run by one or two staff (July and October 2026).
osaka_seafood_izakaya_ikou.notes: [Izakaya · Umeda, Doyama, a quiet seafood counter] A sixteen-seat seafood izakaya up a flight of stairs at the edge of Doyama, near Nakazakicho, reopened in January 2026, with a ten-seat counter and a private room. The cooking is careful Japanese: five-kind sashimi platters, today's simmered fish, monkfish liver in Nara pickles, grilled crab miso, and a seasonal clay-pot rice to finish, with over seventy sakes. Drink plans run ¥2,200–3,300, or ¥5,500 with a set course. Diners praise the calm, the freshness and the speed of a one- or two-person team. Heated tobacco only; open every day.

roles: Cook and drinks staff (unnamed; one or two people, 2026)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): an adult hideaway on the second floor of a building away from the bustle of Umeda and Nakazakicho; seasonal seafood; fresh sashimi, today's simmered dish, sushi, tempura and seasonal kamameshi; courses with all-you-can-drink from ¥5,500; counter seating and a fully private room. Renewal opening January 1, 2026 (April 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: "The crab miso is truly a thief of sake!" — April 2026.
"The restaurant operates with two staff members: one for drinks and one for cooking" — July 2026.
"Although the restaurant was operating with just one staff member, the food and drinks were served promptly." — October 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Dishes explained at the counter (April 2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reopened January 2026; reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_yoshi_carbona.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the menu centres on pasta and oven-baked pizza.
osaka_yoshi_carbona.vegan_detail: Not vegan: carbonara with egg, cheese and pancetta; cured meats and cheese.
osaka_yoshi_carbona.hours_raw: Lunch Mon–Fri 11:00–14:00 (last order 13:30); dinner Tue–Sat and holidays 17:00–23:00 (food last order 21:30, drinks 22:30); closed Sundays (Tabelog). Bookings for dinner only; dinner is reservation only (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened August 2025 (October 2026 review). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). Seats: 9 on Tabelog, 12 in the shop text, about 10 per a diner (5 counter, a booth for 4); private hire from 2; non-smoking (Tabelog; 2026). On a mezzanine up a few stairs; karaoke available (2026).
osaka_yoshi_carbona.notes: [Italian · Kitashinchi, a carbonara bar on a mezzanine] A hidden ten-odd-seat Italian bar on a half-floor near the Midosuji end of Kitashinchi, opened in August 2025 and named for its carbonara and, in part, its owner's name. The carbonara is Roman-style, no cream, with miso slipped in for depth; around it come cured meats with the house olive oil, a potato salad with an original dressing, Italian beers and a Margherita from a 450°C oven. Dinner is reservation-only and about ¥5,000–8,000 a head; the ¥990 weekday pasta lunch is a Kitashinchi bargain. There is karaoke too, and the room can be booked privately for meetings.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed; the "Yoshi" in the shop name comes from the owner’s name, August 2026)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a signature carbonara in the traditional Roman style without cream or milk, with miso for umami; Italian wines, beers, whisky and cocktails; original olive oil and dressings; a cozy space for anniversaries, parties and business meetings. An August 2026 diner: "Karubona" comes from carbonara and "Yoshi" from the owner's name. Opened August 2025 (October 2026 review). The master makes each lunch dish to order (September 2026).

anecdotes.text: "Interestingly, it contains miso as a secret ingredient." — August 2026, on the carbonara.
"The pizza, cooked at 450 degrees, was piping hot with a crispy yet fluffy crust" — September 2026.
"What's interesting about this place is that you can enjoy a full meal and even sing karaoke!" — October 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: A friendly chef who talks through the dishes (August 2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; opened August 2025; reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_okonomiyaki_naoya_namba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki batter, yakisoba noodles and tenkasu are wheat.
osaka_okonomiyaki_naoya_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: okonomiyaki with pork and egg, and the batter usually uses dashi.
osaka_okonomiyaki_naoya_namba.hours_raw: Mon–Fri and the days around holidays 17:00–24:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–24:00; closing days vary (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; held 15 minutes; a two-hour limit when busy (Tabelog). One drink and one dish per person (October 2026). Cards including UnionPay, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). 73 seats at tables with teppan grills, a few without; non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 22 March 2025 as the group's third shop (Tabelog).
osaka_okonomiyaki_naoya_namba.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Sennichimae, curry yakisoba and table-side grilling] A bright, modern okonomiyaki house three minutes from Namba, opened in 2025 as the third shop of a small group founded by an owner who, the shop says, looked up to a grandfather who was a comedian. Staff grill everything at your table: okonomiyaki with chopped pork in a fluffy batter and a crunchy cap of tenkasu, and the signature curry yakisoba, best stirred with a raw egg. The Osaka set covers okonomiyaki, yakisoba, negiyaki and tonpei-yaki for sharing; three diners ate well for about ¥7,000 in August 2026. Okonomiyaki can take a while once the quicker dishes arrive. One drink and one dish each.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: opened 22 March 2025 as the third shop of お好み焼き なお家, inspired by the owner's admiration for a grandfather who was a former comedian; carefully made batter with attention to the cabbage, its cut and preparation, fluffy inside and crisp with tenkasu; the signature curry yakisoba. An October 2026 review mentions the group's Awaza shop.

anecdotes.text: "I ordered the signature curry yakisoba with extra cabbage, a tonpeiyaki, and a mixed okonomiyaki topped with an egg." — October 2026, at the Namba shop after visits to Awaza.
"For around JPY 7000, three of us enjoyed okonomiyaki, negiyaki, yakisoba, and one drink each!" — August 2026.
"However, the okonomiyaki took a while to cook, and by then, I was already quite full..." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): お好み焼き なお家 なんば店、お好み焼き・居酒屋・鉄板焼き、大阪市中央区千日前1-8-18 安本ビル、なんば駅・近鉄日本橋駅から徒歩3分、月〜金・祝前後17:00〜24:00、土日祝11:30〜14:00・17:00〜24:00、休みは変わることも、予約可 (15分で取り消し、混雑時は2時間制)、カード (銀聯も)・iD・QUICPay・PayPay 可、73席、禁煙、2025年3月22日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): お好み焼き なお家の3号店、元芸人の祖父にあこがれた店主の本格的なお好み焼き、キャベツの産地や切り方にこだわったふわふわで天かすでサクサクの生地、名物のカレー焼きそば。口コミ(2026年5月〜10月): 店の人が焼いてくれる、豚を生地に混ぜる、天かすを全体にのせる、チーズの豚玉、甘めの焼きそば、しょうがと醤油のねぎ焼き、とん平焼き、大阪セット (お好み焼き、焼きそば、ねぎ焼き、とん平焼き)、3人で7,000円ほど、カレー焼きそばに生卵、Awaza の店、1ドリンク1オーダー制、お好み焼きが焼けるまで時間がかかるという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff cook at the table; overseas tourists (October 2026). No English menu evidence found.

osaka_tempura_taroujirou_sennichimae.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura batter is wheat flour; oysters and sashimi come raw, but share the kitchen.
osaka_tempura_taroujirou_sennichimae.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood tempura and oysters; tentsuyu is made with dashi.
osaka_tempura_taroujirou_sennichimae.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 17:00–24:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–24:00; last order 23:30; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Lunch last order 14:30 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; call if more than 15 minutes late; often full at weekends (Tabelog; June 2026). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 23 seats: a 12-seat counter facing the fryer and 11 at tables (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 22 August 2015 (Tabelog).
osaka_tempura_taroujirou_sennichimae.notes: [Tempura · Sennichimae, by the piece from ¥100] A small tempura bar on the Aioibashi shopping street where a chef trained at the renowned Daikichi in Sakai fries each piece to order in front of a 12-seat counter. Pieces start at ¥100, with a choice of salts and dipping sauces; red shrimp, mentaiko-and-shiso fish and a molten soft-boiled egg are favourites. Oysters are the other draw, raw or as tempura, along with sashimi and a sake list chosen by an expert. A five-year regular calls it the best tempura in Namba and books ahead at weekends; one October 2026 diner found the food average. Weekend lunch sets; closed Wednesdays.

roles: Chef (unnamed) trained at Daikichi in Sakai (Tabelog); a sake expert on staff (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a chef who honed skills at the renowned Daikichi in Sakai; seasonal fish, vegetables and rice; attention to oil; fresh fish and shellfish as sashimi, grilled or tempura; a sake expert on hand; opened 22 August 2015.
chef_bio.specialty: Tempura by the piece; fresh oysters.

anecdotes.text: "I've been coming here regularly for about five years, and I'm always completely satisfied." — June 2026.
"The light and crispy tempura starts at just JPY 100 each, and you can choose from various dipping sauces and salts" — September 2026.
"The oysters were quite large and had very little odor, making them incredibly delicious." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 天ぷら たろじろう、天ぷら・海鮮・オイスターバー、大阪市中央区千日前1-8-20 高橋ビル 1F、なんば駅・日本橋駅から徒歩5分、月火木金17:00〜24:00、土日祝11:30〜24:00 (L.O.23:30)、水曜休み、ランチの L.O.14:30、予約可 (15分以上遅れる場合は連絡を)、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、23席 (カウンター12、テーブル11)、2015年8月22日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): Sakai の名店 Daikichi で腕を磨いた料理人、油へのこだわり、季節の魚と野菜、刺身や焼き物や天ぷらで食べる鮮魚と貝、日本酒に詳しいスタッフ。口コミ(2026年1月〜10月): 1個100円からの天ぷら、選べるたれと塩、大きな赤えび、かぼちゃ、明太子としその魚、げそ、万願寺とうがらし、ゴーヤ、玉ねぎ、半熟卵、生がき (Hokkaido も)、かきの天ぷら、さんまの刺身、白子ポン酢、ランチの天ぷら定食、ざるそばのセット、赤星、Aioibashi の商店街、5年通う常連、週末は満席が多い、ふつうだったという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter ordering piece by piece; many overseas guests (July 2026). No English menu evidence found.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_hubble_nishishinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu is pizza, pasta, taco rice and fries.
osaka_hubble_nishishinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Pasta and pizza use cream and cheese; the BBQ is meat.
osaka_hubble_nishishinsaibashi.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–23:30 (food last order 22:00): lunch 11:30–15:00, café and dinner 15:00–23:30; irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; cancellation fees of 50–100% for courses and ¥4,000 a head for no-show table bookings (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 60 seats: about 50 on sofas and 40 on a rooftop terrace with lawn, semi-private rooms for 10–20 at ¥700 a head (Tabelog; February 2026). Smoking allowed; shisha (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Opened 15 January 2022 (Tabelog).
osaka_hubble_nishishinsaibashi.notes: [Café-bar · Nishi-Shinsaibashi, a rooftop terrace and shisha] A spacious fourth-floor Italian café-bar four minutes from Shinsaibashi Station, with deep sofas inside and a lawned rooftop terrace that feels far from the city. Lunch brings pizza that reviewers rate highly and an oyster and spinach cream pasta; in the evening it becomes a shisha lounge and party space, and summer groups book all-you-can-drink barbecues on the terrace, with a cooling system on hot nights. Portions are generous but some find the food salty, and drinks can be slow when staff are few. Shisha smoke is everywhere, which one January 2026 non-smoker found too much.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: Italian, bar and izakaya on 4F of Crice Nikko; wagyu and handmade Italian dishes; private hire for 40–50; shisha and meat dishes; a rooftop terrace BBQ; opened 15 January 2022. A review describes it as a sister of Safari Shinsaibashi.

anecdotes.text: "The spacious second-floor terrace offers a refreshing atmosphere, making it hard to believe you're in the heart of the city." — February 2026, with a dog along.
"I didn’t realize it was a shisha bar and came hoping to enjoy some prosciutto, but my friend isn’t fond of shisha aromas, so we only ordered soft drinks." — January 2026.
"Most of the dishes were quite salty, but I think they would be great for younger guests due to their generous portions." — April 2026.

It can be packed, but pizzas come out fast, and staff are happy to bring out a birthday plate. It doubles as a shisha lounge: e-cigarettes at every seat, cigarettes on the terrace, and one May 2026 regular waited in vain for the charcoal to be changed. Children's menu; pets welcome.

osaka_robata_kitaro_sushi_douguyasuji.notes: [Izakaya · Doguyasuji Yokocho, sushi plus robata at the hearth] The robata version of the Osaka sushi name 喜多郎寿し, opened in February 2024 in the Doguyasuji Yokocho alley five minutes from Namba: sushi from ¥330 a plate alongside fish, shrimp and Unzen ham grilled over an open hearth in front of the first-floor counter. Diners in 2026 recommend booking the counter to watch the grill, and praise the grilled kinki, the sea-bream yukhoe and the friendly staff; one Sunday visit had a strict two-hour limit.

roles: Staff unnamed; a shop of the 喜多郎寿し group (kitarou.jp)
chef_bio.background: Per kitarou.jp, the group runs the plain sushi shops 喜多郎寿し (心斎橋, ウラなんば, お初天神), the robata shops 炉端喜多郎寿し (兎我野町, 道具屋筋横丁), 角打ち喜多郎 and other brands in Osaka, Okinawa and Thailand. Per Tabelog, this shop pairs ¥330 sushi with robatayaki of Tohoku origin in a warm wooden room; opened 14 February 2024.

anecdotes.text: "The counter has an impressive robata grill, and watching the fish and ham being cooked makes you want to try everything on the menu—it's a dangerous seat!" — October 2026, fourth visit.
"I highly recommend the counter seats over the second floor." — August 2026.
"The grilled Kinki fish was amazing!" — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 喜多郎寿し公式サイト (kitarou.jp): 店舗は喜多郎寿し (心斎橋店、ウラなんば店、お初天神店)、炉端喜多郎寿し (兎我野町店、道具屋筋横丁店)、角打ち喜多郎 なんば店、その他 (道頓堀酒処喜多蔵、斬新和菜出雲、那覇久茂地店など)、お品書きは寿し・炉端焼き・逸品・コース。食べログ (英語版): 寿し炉端 喜多郎寿し 道具屋筋横丁店、難波千日前14-18 道具屋筋横丁、なんば駅から徒歩5分、2024年2月14日オープン、平日17:00〜翌1:00、土日祝16:00〜24:00、2026年5月から不定休、チャージあり、330円からの寿しと東北発祥の炉端焼き。メニュー (2025年11月): 泉州のしらす、刺身盛り、鯛のユッケ、たこの唐揚げ、特大海老の自家製タルタル、とろいわしの焼き、のどぐろやきんきの煮付け、鯛のかぶと煮、本まぐろのかまの唐揚げ、雲仙ハム。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月): 1階のカウンターで炉端焼きを見られる (2階よりカウンター)、きんきの焼き、鯛の塩ユッケ、かつおのたたき、サッポロラガー赤星、スタッフが親切、日曜は2時間制。

cultural_comfort.note: Pays with Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). No English menu or English-speaking staff found in the sources.

existence.note: Group site listing the shop and Tabelog listing with a May 2026 notice; reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_sushi_takeuchi_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. A sushi omakase with small dishes; a December 2025 diner says the staff accommodated allergies on a same-day booking (review).
osaka_sushi_takeuchi_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi and Japanese-cuisine counter; lunch also offers Kobe beef and eel bowls (Tabelog).
osaka_sushi_takeuchi_namba.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (Tabelog). Reservations taken. Cards (incl. UnionPay), transport IC and other e-money, PayPay, Rakuten Pay, WeChat Pay. 22 seats at a counter, tables and a semi-private room for 4; private hire for up to 20 (Tabelog).
osaka_sushi_takeuchi_namba.notes: [Sushi · Namba, a calm counter a minute from the station] A sushi counter with private rooms in a building behind Namba HIPS, opened in July 2022, a quiet surprise on a busy street a minute from Namba Station. Lunch courses of about eight nigiri with small dishes cost around ¥5,000–7,000 in 2026; evenings are omakase. Diners praise the careful nigiri, the chu-toro and the attentive chef, who handled one diner's allergies on a same-day booking; one July diner found it classic sushi with nothing unusual, another notes lunch prices have risen.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, top-quality sushi by skilled chefs with seasonal ingredients, omakase in the evening and sushi lunch courses, Kobe beef and unagi bowls at lunch; opened 15 July 2022. Reviews note many visitors from abroad given the location.

anecdotes.text: "The interior exudes a sense of luxury, yet it’s not overly formal, allowing for a relaxed dining experience." — December 2025, course.
"I can't believe there was a sushi restaurant on this street!" — March 2026, special lunch.
"There weren't any particularly unique toppings or interesting arrangements, but it was classic sushi." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 日本語の情報源は未確認。食べログ (英語版): 鮨 たけうち、難波1-7-6 ニュー豊楽ビル 1F、各線なんば駅から徒歩1分、2022年7月15日オープン、毎日11:30〜15:00・17:00〜23:00、22席 (カウンター、テーブル、4名の半個室)、20名まで貸切、旬の素材の寿司と創作の日本料理、夜はおまかせ、昼は寿司ランチのコース、神戸牛やうなぎの丼。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年7月): なんばHIPSの裏、ランチのコース約5,000〜7,000円、中とろ、真鯛、炙りのぼたん海老、いくら丼、自家製からすみ、当日の予約でもアレルギーに対応、外国からの客も多い、値上がりしたという声、定番の寿司で特に変わったネタはないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: A December 2025 diner saw many visitors from abroad. No English menu or English-speaking staff found in the sources.

staff_allergy_handling: A December 2025 diner says allergies were accommodated on a same-day booking (review).

osaka_shibaitaroka_dotonbori.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: takoyaki and okonomiyaki of wheat batter with a dashi-flavoured batter (reviews).
osaka_shibaitaroka_dotonbori.vegan_detail: Not vegan: takoyaki with octopus and a dashi batter; okonomiyaki with pork or mixed fillings (reviews).
osaka_shibaitaroka_dotonbori.hours_raw: Opening hours are not listed on Tabelog; diners report visits from lunch to after 23:00 (2025–2026 reviews). Phone 11:00–20:00 on weekdays; reservations taken (Tabelog). No cards; e-money accepted, no QR (Tabelog). 30 seats: a first-floor counter and 23 table seats on the second floor; non-smoking (Tabelog). Pay at the entrance and pick up food downstairs; no water served (2025 reviews).
osaka_shibaitaroka_dotonbori.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Dotonbori, takoyaki at the gateway to Dotonbori] A loud-named takoyaki and okonomiyaki stand at the entrance to Dotonbori, opened in September 2023 and featured on TV, where you pay at the door and eat at the counter or upstairs. Diners in 2025–2026, many of whom are visitors, call the takoyaki crisp, gooey and dashi-rich, for some the best in Dotonbori, and like the sauce and the reasonable prices. No water is served, so order a drink. Hours are not published on Tabelog.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, opened 1 September 2023 with 30 seats over two floors. A March 2026 diner says it has been featured on TV several times.

anecdotes.text: "During my trip to Osaka, I tried several famous places in Umeda and Dotonbori, but personally, this was the most delicious." — March 2025.
"You pay at the entrance and then go down to get your food even from the second floor." — October 2025.
"You can really taste the dashi flavor in the batter, and the seasoning is perfectly balanced—not too strong." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 日本語の情報源は未確認。食べログ (英語版): しばいたろか!!、道頓堀1-7-5、JR難波駅・南海なんば駅から徒歩10分、2023年9月1日オープン、営業時間の記載なし、平日11〜20時は電話可、予約可、カード不可・電子マネー可、30席 (1階カウンター、2階テーブル23)、禁煙。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年9月): 外はカリッと中はとろとろのたこ焼き、出汁の効いた生地、塩のたこ焼き8個700円、2種のソースで8個900円、トッピング400円、ミックスのお好み焼き1,600円、入口で支払い2階からも下へ取りに行く、水は出ない、テレビで何度も紹介、道頓堀の入口、観光客が多い。

osaka_dining_cafe_bar_flat_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Omurice, curries, rice bowls and steaks sit beside pasta, pork cutlet and fried shrimp (Tabelog menu; reviews); the demi-glace and curry are not described.
osaka_dining_cafe_bar_flat_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg, wagyu, pork and seafood dishes; no vegan options are described.
osaka_dining_cafe_bar_flat_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Mon–Thu 12:00–23:30; Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 12:00–24:00; Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00; irregular closing days; may close early when ingredients run out (Tabelog). Reservations taken, seat-only bookings for one welcome; a 10% late fee after 15 minutes and 20% after 30 minutes; no long stays without ordering (Tabelog). Cards (incl. UnionPay), PayPay, d Barai, Alipay, WeChat Pay; no e-money. Pets allowed, with food for them (official site).
osaka_dining_cafe_bar_flat_shinsaibashi.notes: [Yoshoku · Shinsaibashi, golden omurice since 1996] A green-filled second-floor café bar just off Shinsaibashi-suji, open since 1996 and run by owner 尾崎英司, who has appeared on Yomiuri TV and NHK. The house is famous for its fluffy omurice of rich red eggs and offers A5 wagyu bowls, curries and pesto pasta, with sofas for long evenings and pets welcome. The site greets international visitors in English and a 2025 diner saw English and Chinese menus. Diners in 2023–2025 like the generous dishes and comfortable sofas; one found it quite pricey. The latest Tabelog reviews date from 2025.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site, Dining Cafe Bar Flat opened in 1996; owner 尾崎英司 has appeared on Yomiuri TV's 「ご馳走コンシェルジュ」 and NHK's 「ええやんこの人」; the shop welcomes pets and international travellers. A September 2023 reviewer describes the omurice curry with premium red eggs as "cherished for 28 years".

anecdotes.text: "Experience the exquisite Omurice Curry with premium red eggs, cherished for 28 years" — September 2023.
"Given that the menu is available in both English and Chinese, I wonder if they are targeting foreign tourists." — September 2025.
"The spacious table seating was fantastic, and the sofas were incredibly comfortable!" — October 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 心斎橋の「ダイニングカフェバー フラット」、ディナーデートに人気、海外の旅行者向けの英語の案内 (心斎橋で外国人に人気の店の一つ)、店主尾崎英司が読売テレビ「ご馳走コンシェルジュ」とNHK「ええやんこの人」に出演、ペット同伴可でペットのご飯も用意、1996年オープン。食べログ (英語版): ダイニングカフェバー フラット、東心斎橋1-18-20 心斎橋EOビル 2F、心斎橋駅5・6番出口から徒歩1分、月〜木12:00〜23:30、金土・祝前日12:00〜24:00、日祝12:00〜23:00、不定休、遅刻は15分で10%・30分で20%の料金。メニュー (2025年9月): 黄金のオムライス (660万食以上)、神戸牛すじとハンバーグのオムカレー、A5黒毛和牛の焼肉丼・すき焼き丼、A5ローストビーフといくらの丼、うなぎとだし巻きの丼、30年熟成の心斎橋カレー。口コミ (2023年6月〜2025年10月): 牛ひつまぶし、バジルのジェノベーゼ、赤玉子のオムライスカレー (28年)、緑の多い内装、ソファ、食べ放題コース、英語と中国語のメニュー、値段は高めという声。

cultural_comfort.note: The official site welcomes international travellers in English, and a September 2025 diner saw menus in English and Chinese. No evidence on English-speaking staff.

existence.note: Official site live (read 2026-11-02) and Tabelog listing with a September 2025 menu; the latest Tabelog reviews date from October 2025.

osaka_yakitori_sasaki_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Skewers come with tare or salt; seseri with ponzu, tsukune with egg yolk and grilled rice balls are on the menu.
osaka_yakitori_sasaki_namba.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and a July 2026 reviewer mentions vegetable dishes, but the house is a chicken specialist and nothing is described as vegan.
osaka_yakitori_sasaki_namba.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 17:00–00:30, last order food 23:30, drinks 24:00; closed Sundays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, a must at weekends (May 2026, October 2025); groups of 10+ by phone (Tabelog). Appetiser ¥360 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC, iD and QUICPay; no QR payment (Tabelog). 38 seats (10 counter, 28 table), a 2nd floor for groups; non-smoking (Tabelog). QR ordering (November 2025, July 2026).
osaka_yakitori_sasaki_namba.notes: [Yakitori · Namba, Daisen chicken by exit 12] A wood-toned yakitori counter of more than twenty years right by Namba Station exit 12, reopened with a renovated second floor in 2018. Order the omakase ten skewers (¥1,918, half tare, half salt), the seseri ponzu and the tsukune with egg yolk, with sake from a good regional list. Busy every night: book, especially at weekends. Closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): a yakitori shop of over 20 years that reopened in May 2018 after renovating the 2nd floor; Daisen jidori chicken sent direct from Tottori.

anecdotes.text: "By before 10 PM, I noticed some salarymen coming in alone after work." — February 2026, a fourth visit.
"I went on a Saturday, but it was fully booked. Reservations are a must on weekends!" — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): やき鳥 ササキ、焼き鳥・鶏料理・居酒屋、大阪市中央区難波4-2-7、なんば駅12番出口すぐ、月〜土・祝17:00〜翌0:30 (料理 L.O. 23:30、ドリンク L.O. 24:00)、日曜休み、予約可 (10名以上は電話)、お通し360円、カード・電子マネー可、QR 決済不可、38席 (カウンター10、テーブル28)、2階は貸切可、禁煙、ベジタリアン対応の表示。創業20年以上、2018年5月に2階を改装してリニューアル、Tottori から直送の Daisen の地鶏の焼き鳥、たたき、刺身、地酒。口コミ(2025年9月〜2026年9月): おまかせ10本1,918円 (タレ5本、塩5本)、メガ生ビール1,260円、ねぎたっぷりのせせりポン酢、肝、ねぎま、ぼんじり、ベーコン巻きの半熟卵、焼きおにぎり、さつまいものバター、卵黄つくね、梅きゅう、鶏皮、だし巻き、軟骨、Kikuhime の吟醸、QR コードで注文、週末は予約必須、1本100円ちょっとから。

cultural_comfort.note: QR ordering on your phone; counter seats suit solo diners (2025–2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

osaka_l_and_l_bar_nishishinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Hummus comes with pita (December 2022); the menu has homemade-dough pizza, chicken schnitzel and pasta alongside lamb and spare ribs.
osaka_l_and_l_bar_nishishinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and a vegetarian set (October 2024); hummus is chickpeas, tahini, olive oil and lemon (December 2022). Nothing is described as vegan.
osaka_l_and_l_bar_nishishinsaibashi.hours_raw: Daily 08:00–05:00; open year-round (Tabelog). Breakfast served (Tabelog; August 2026); lunch sets until 17:00 (December 2017). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and QR payment; no e-money (Tabelog). 95 seats with counter, tables, sofas and a terrace, plus a basement club space for 20–40 with DJ gear (Tabelog; December 2022); smoking allowed (Tabelog); shisha served. Reviews are sparse and spread over 2017–2026.
osaka_l_and_l_bar_nishishinsaibashi.notes: [Bar and Israeli food · Amerikamura edge, shisha nearly round the clock] A dim, art-hung bar and restaurant open from 8:00 to 5:00, mixing locals, travellers and expats over shisha, cocktails and Israeli plates. Try the hummus with pita, the lamb and the spare ribs; it serves breakfast in the morning and is liveliest late. Smoking and shisha inside. Reviews are thin and spread over many years, so check the current menu.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: produced by a foreign owner, with new art on the walls each month and a basement club space (December 2022); lamb cooked by an Israeli chef (December 2022). Culture Trip describes it as a backpacker-style meeting place of locals, foreigners and expats (search result).

anecdotes.text: "Before COVID, the place was crowded with foreigners and had a club-like atmosphere. However, when I visited after a long time, it was very empty." — September 2022.
"There were no customers during breakfast, but I have the impression that it's always lively in the evening." — August 2026, about 9:00 AM.
"My first experience with Israeli cuisine in my life! It was even more delicious than I imagined!" — June 2024.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: L&L Bar&Restaurant、ダイニングバー・ヨーロッパ料理・パスタ、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-16-13 宝泉ビル 1F、なんば駅 (四つ橋線) から徒歩5分、100 Yen Lawson の前、毎日8:00〜翌5:00、年中無休、予約可、チャージなし、カード・QR 決済可、電子マネー不可、95席、地下の貸切スペース (20〜40名)、喫煙可、朝食あり、ベジタリアン対応の表示。口コミ(2017年〜2026年): 外国人のオーナー、イスラエル料理、フムスとピタ880円 (税抜)、イスラエル人シェフのラム、手作り生地のピザ、ベジタリアンセット、チキンシュニッツェル、レアのラムチョップ、スペアリブ、ジャークチキン、シーシャ、朝食のパン、チーズケーキ、500円のカレーランチ (2017年)、コロナ前は外国人客でにぎわっていたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Foreign-owned, with a mixed local and expat crowd (2022; Culture Trip). Smoking and shisha inside.

existence.note: Tabelog listing open; recent reviews are few (breakfast in August 2026, a cheesecake in October 2026).

osaka_sumiyaki_kitchen_tenten_shinsaibas.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Skewers come with tare or salt; the menu has chicken ajillo, fried burdock, fried wings, an appetiser of Napolitan pasta and grilled rice balls.
osaka_sumiyaki_kitchen_tenten_shinsaibas.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken yakitori izakaya with chicken sashimi.
osaka_sumiyaki_kitchen_tenten_shinsaibas.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 14:00–24:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–24:00; last order 23:30; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Daytime drinking welcome (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; the shop phones to confirm online bookings; note allergies and dislikes in the booking (Tabelog). Appetiser and service charge ¥440, not for course orders (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). 32 seats: counter, tables, sunken-kotatsu private rooms for 8–12 and semi-private tables; smoking allowed at all tables (Tabelog; December 2024). Mobile ordering (August 2025).
osaka_sumiyaki_kitchen_tenten_shinsaibas.notes: [Yakitori · Shinsaibashi-suji, daytime drinking over binchotan] A yakitori izakaya off Shinsaibashi-suji that opens at 14:00 on weekdays and noon at weekends, grilling Daisen chicken over Tosa binchotan. Order the five-skewer set, the tsukimi tsukune in egg yolk and, if you eat raw chicken, the breast-liver-heart sashimi. Smoking is allowed at every table. Reviews are mixed: some rate it highly, others found the course average (December 2024).

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): fresh chicken skewered one by one and grilled over Tosa binchotan; invoice-registered. Reviewers name Daisen chicken from Tottori, processed that morning (March 2025, October 2026). Gurunavi lists Oyama chicken, Nagasaki Hojuton pork and Genmai Kuroushi beef (search result).

anecdotes.text: "I was looking for a place where smoking was allowed and I could enjoy a leisurely drink during the day, and I found this spot." — December 2025, lunch before a concert.
"The course menu was quite standard, and the taste was just average ... Since smoking is allowed at all tables, it might be a good option for gatherings with many smokers." — December 2024.
"When I asked the staff, ... kindly prepared a hot Oolong for me!" — August 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 炭焼キッチン Tenten、焼き鳥・鍋・居酒屋、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1丁目4-3 トダビル 1F、心斎橋駅5・6番出口から徒歩3分、月〜金14:00〜24:00、土日祝12:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:30)、不定休、昼飲み歓迎、予約可 (ネット予約は確認の電話あり、アレルギーや苦手なものは備考に)、お通しとサービス料440円 (コースは対象外)、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、32席、掘りごたつの個室 (8〜12名)、半個室、喫煙可。Tosa の備長炭で焼く手刺しの焼き鳥、名物の月見つくね、全国の地酒、120分飲み放題つきのコース3,500円から。口コミ(2024年10月〜2026年10月): Tottori の Daisen の朝引きの鶏、レバ刺し781円、鶏の炭火アヒージョ1,243円、焼き鳥の5本の盛り合わせ1,265円、月見つくね2本572円、ささみ・レバー・ハツの刺身盛り1,200円、ごぼうの唐揚げ、手羽の唐揚げ、お通しのナポリタン、全席喫煙可、コースはふつうという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Mobile ordering (August 2025); smoking at all tables. No English evidence found.

staff_allergy_handling: The shop asks guests to note allergies and dislikes when booking (Tabelog).

osaka_teppanyaki_minami_swissotel.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Courses are grilled seafood, wagyu with three salts, garlic rice with miso soup, and dessert; a June 2025 diner's allergy-related ingredient changes were accommodated.
osaka_teppanyaki_minami_swissotel.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu and seafood teppanyaki; courses end with miso soup.
osaka_teppanyaki_minami_swissotel.hours_raw: Mon–Thu 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:00; Fri and the day before holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:30; Sat 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:30; Sun and holidays 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; walk-ins on the day possible (June 2026); seats held for two hours from the booking time, 100% fee for same-day cancellation (ikyu, search result). Listed prices include a 13% service charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), transport IC and other e-money, PayPay, au PAY, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 35 counter seats around teppan plates, partitioned sections for groups (November 2025); non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; hotel parking with free hours for diners (Tabelog). Staff and chefs speak English and Chinese (June 2025).
osaka_teppanyaki_minami_swissotel.notes: [Teppanyaki · Namba, hotel counter over a garden] The Swissotel Nankai Osaka's teppanyaki room on the 10th floor, straight up from Nankai Namba Station, where chefs grill kuroge wagyu, abalone and Senshu vegetables at counters facing a Japanese garden. Lunch is the way in (a weekday 80 g F1 sirloin set); the April 2026 chef course was ¥21,000, service included. English and Chinese spoken. Reviews from 2024–2025 note largely overseas staff and some uneven service.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: the teppanyaki restaurant on the 10th floor of Swissotel Nankai Osaka (formerly Nankai South Tower Hotel, per a long-time diner). Vegetables come from Senshu (April 2026). A June 2025 reviewer notes multicultural chefs and staff who speak English and Chinese.
chef_bio.specialty: Kuroge wagyu and abalone on the teppan.

anecdotes.text: "I have allergies, so I requested some ingredient changes." — June 2025, the premium course.
"The late last order time and the ability to accommodate walk-ins on the day are very helpful." — June 2026, a weekday lunch.
"Most of the staff are foreigners, making it feel like a different world where Japanese is not understood. The food is average and not worth the price." — October 2024.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: みなみ、鉄板焼き・魚介、大阪市中央区難波5-1-60 スイスホテル南海大阪 10F、南海なんば駅直結 (3階改札から専用エスカレーター)、月〜木11:30〜15:00、17:30〜21:00、金・祝前日11:30〜15:00、17:30〜21:30、土11:00〜15:00、17:30〜21:30、日・祝11:00〜15:00、17:30〜21:00、予約可、表示価格はサービス料13%込み、カード・電子マネー・QR 決済可、35席 (カウンターのみ)、禁煙、車いす可、ホテルの駐車場。日本庭園を望むカウンターで最高級の黒毛和牛、鮮魚、季節の野菜、懐石風の前菜。一休: 予約時間から2時間制、当日キャンセルは100%。口コミ(2024年2月〜2026年10月): シェフコース21,000円 (Senshu の野菜のサラダとサーモンのカルパッチョ、活けの Ezo あわび、えびといか、黒毛和牛のヒレとロース、ガーリックライス、フランベの果物とチーズケーキ)、平日の Japanese F1 ロース80gのランチ、塩3種、ホタテ、スープ、アレルギーで食材を替えてくれた、当日でも入れる、英語と中国語を話すスタッフ、スタッフの多くが外国人で日本語が通じにくいという声 (2024年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Chefs and staff speak English and Chinese (June 2025); set courses.

staff_allergy_handling: Ingredient changes for allergies made on a course (review, June 2025).

osaka_salon_de_mon_cher_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The Dojima Roll, cakes, sandwiches and pasta are wheat-based; the shaved ice and parfaits are where to ask, as sauces and toppings are not described.
osaka_salon_de_mon_cher_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fresh-cream rolls, cakes, egg sandwiches and ice cream; the fruit shaved ice may be the closest, but cream is inside some (August 2026).
osaka_salon_de_mon_cher_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–19:00 (last order 18:30); irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations (Tabelog); otherwise write your name and wait, sometimes 30 minutes to an hour at weekends and in summer (July–August 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). 31 seats, eight of them in special rooms, with sofas and a counter; non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). Opened 3 October 2013 and reopened in August 2020 (Tabelog).
osaka_salon_de_mon_cher_shinsaibashi.notes: [Sweets · Nishi-Shinsaibashi, the Dojima Roll maker's tearoom] The only eat-in salon of Mon cher, the maker of the Dojima Roll, in the Kansai region: an ornate, Versailles-like room of sofas just by Shinsaibashi Station, where you can eat the roll cake with an egg sandwich, take a silver-stand afternoon tea, or, in summer, queue for its delicate strawberry and pistachio shaved ice. Write your name and wait; weekends and hot days bring 30–60 minute lines. Diners in 2026 loved the setting and the kakigori; one regular found the egg sandwich changed for the worse. Open daily 10:00–19:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: the only eat-in salon of Mon cher in the Kansai region, serving afternoon tea, fruit sandwiches and kakigori in a luxurious space; opened 3 October 2013 and reopened in August 2020.
chef_bio.philosophy: Special sweets in a luxurious space away from the everyday (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "I wrote my name down, and since some people were absent, I was seated fairly quickly." — August 2026, strawberry and pistachio kakigori ¥1,528.
"The afternoon tea was served on a beautiful silver stand, adorned with an array of sweets and sandwiches" — October 2026.
"I had previously tried the egg sandwich, but I was disappointed to see that its appearance had completely changed." — July 2026, a returning visitor.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): サロン・ド・モンシェール 本店～心斎橋～、カフェ・ケーキ、西心斎橋1-13-21、Shinsaibashi 駅16番出口、毎日10:00〜19:00 (L.O.18:30)、不定休、予約可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー不可、31席 (うち8席は特別室)、禁煙、子ども可、テイクアウト、2013年10月3日オープン、2020年8月リニューアルオープン、関西で唯一のモンシェールのイートインサロン、アフタヌーンティー、フルーツサンド、かき氷。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): Dojima Roll と玉子サンドのセット、季節のプレート (Dojima Roll、チーズケーキ、マカロン、モンブラン)、銀のスタンドのアフタヌーンティー、いちごとピスタチオのかき氷1,528円、桃とシャインマスカットのかき氷、いちごのパフェ、クラシックショコラ、パスタ、名前を書いて待つ、30分〜1時間待ち、玉子サンドが変わったという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Write your name on the waiting list at the door (August 2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_taishu_yakiniku_birichan_shinsaiba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Salted cuts with lemon are the plainest; marinated cuts, the self-serve curry, cold noodles, bibimbap and yukgaejang are not described.
osaka_taishu_yakiniku_birichan_shinsaiba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an all-you-can-eat wagyu yakiniku restaurant.
osaka_taishu_yakiniku_birichan_shinsaiba.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); open all year (Tabelog). All-you-can-eat courses: ¥5,500 wagyu tasting course and ¥6,000 kuroge wagyu course, with soft drinks included and alcohol +¥1,100 (September–October 2026); lunch all-you-can-eat ¥2,500 (February 2026); children in third grade and under ¥1,500 (Tabelog). Reservations (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and QR (Tabelog). 62 seats, semi-private and fully private rooms; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; dessert buffet (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened 25 April 2024 (Tabelog).
osaka_taishu_yakiniku_birichan_shinsaiba.notes: [Yakiniku · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, all-you-can-eat wagyu from noon] A fourth-floor all-you-can-eat yakiniku, sister to Taishu Sakaba Birichan, open from 12:00 to 23:00 every day with semi-private rooms. Courses of about ¥5,500–¥6,000 start with a wooden box of thick tongue and marbled kalbi and loin, then let you order freely from wagyu cuts, horumon, seared yukke sushi and stone-pot bibimbap, with a self-serve butcher's curry and ice cream to end; lunch is cheaper. Diners in 2026 call it great value for the quality; one found the loin tough and the yaki-shabu kalbi mostly fat.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: the sister shop of the popular Taishu Sakaba Birichan, serving kuroge wagyu with all-you-can-eat-and-drink courses from 12:00; opened 25 April 2024.

anecdotes.text: "The 'Thick Cut Beef Tongue' with hidden knife cuts was juicy and incredibly satisfying" — October 2026, the wagyu full course.
"The staff taught me how to dip liver in fried garlic, and when I tried it, it was incredibly delicious!" — September 2026.
"However, the loin was a bit tough with less fat, and the black wagyu grilled shabu short ribs ended up being mostly fat and burned" — September 2026, the ¥5,500 course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 大衆焼肉びりちゃん 難波・心斎橋店、焼肉・ホルモン・韓国料理、東心斎橋1-13-23 日宝イルストリートビル 4F、Nagahoribashi 駅から徒歩4分、Shinsaibashi 駅から5分、毎日12:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、年中無休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、62席、完全個室と半個室、禁煙、無料Wi-Fi、デザートビュッフェ、小学3年生以下は食べ飲み放題1,500円、2024年4月25日オープン、人気の大衆酒場びりちゃんの姉妹店、黒毛和牛の食べ飲み放題のコース。口コミ(2026年2月〜11月): 和牛の木箱の盛り合わせ (厚切りタン、塩タン、とろけるカルビ・ロース)、中落ちカルビ、外ハラミ、豚バラ、ホルモン、焼きしゃぶカルビ、炙りユッケ寿司、炙り牛タン寿司、卵黄のユッケ、揚げにんにくのレバー、石焼ビビンバ、冷麺、ユッケジャン、精肉店のカレー、アイス、5,500円と6,000円のコース、ソフトドリンク込み、アルコールは+1,100円、昼の食べ放題2,500円、ロースが固い、焼きしゃぶが脂ばかりという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain how to eat dishes (September 2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_okonomiyaki_mon_namba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki, negiyaki and yakisoba are wheat batter or noodles on shared griddles; the batter includes yam but is mostly flour (October 2025).
osaka_okonomiyaki_mon_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, squid and beef-tendon okonomiyaki and teppan dishes, though Tabelog lists vegetarian options.
osaka_okonomiyaki_mon_namba.hours_raw: Tue–Sun and holidays 18:00–23:00; closed Mondays (generally); lunch may be suspended at busy times (Tabelog). Same-day reservations welcome; call ahead at peak times (Tabelog; March 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money; no service or table charge (Tabelog). 35 seats: a counter of 14 (no griddle at the counter) and tables with griddles, semi-private rooms for 2–6; smoking allowed; free Wi-Fi and outlets; pets allowed, dogs welcome (Tabelog; September 2025–2026). Third floor by a slow lift (October 2025). Opened 15 December 2015 (Tabelog).
osaka_okonomiyaki_mon_namba.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Namba, a dog-friendly okonomiyaki house behind Bic Camera] A third-floor okonomiyaki and teppan restaurant behind Bic Camera, next to Jiyuken, its walls covered in celebrities' signed photos and, rarely for Namba, open to dogs. The staff cook at the counter griddle and bring it to your table: fluffy butatama, a mixed okonomiyaki with a fried egg, pork and squid yakisoba, and a negiyaki that is almost all green onion with beef tendon and lemon. Diners in 2025–2026 call it affordable, local-feeling and easy to walk into; one found the batter a little heavy, and the counter seats have no griddle. Evenings, closed Mondays; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a long-established okonomiyaki and teppanyaki restaurant near Namba Station, frequented by celebrities; opened 15 December 2015. 2025–2026 reviews note signed photos on the walls and young staff at the griddle.

anecdotes.text: "This is an incredibly rare okonomiyaki restaurant in Namba that allows dogs." — September 2026, negiyaki with beef tendon.
"I tried negiyaki for the first time, and I understood why it's so popular; it was much lighter than regular okonomiyaki" — June 2026.
"It seems they use yam in the batter, but I must say that the flour was a bit overpowering, making it feel a little heavy." — October 2025, a mixed okonomiyaki.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): お好み焼き 門、お好み焼き・鉄板焼き・居酒屋、難波3-1-33 南中山ビル 3F、Namba 駅から徒歩5分、Bic Camera の裏、千日前の Jiyuken の隣、火〜日・祝 18:00〜23:00、月曜休み (基本)、混雑時は昼の営業を休むことも、当日予約歓迎、カード・PayPay可、電子マネー不可、サービス料・チャージなし、35席 (カウンター14、テーブル21)、半個室 (2〜6名)、喫煙可、無料Wi-Fi、電源、ペット可、ベジタリアンメニュー、2015年12月15日オープン、芸能人も通う老舗。口コミ(2025年8月〜2026年9月): 豚玉、目玉焼きのせミックス、広島焼き、生地に山芋、牛すじのねぎ焼き1,350円、豚いか焼きそば990円、だし巻き550円、いか焼き、とん平焼き、キムチ、唐揚げ、ポテトサラダ、焼酎のコーヒーハイボール、壁にサイン、犬連れ可、カウンターには鉄板なし、生地が少し重いという声も。

osaka_passion_et_nature_shin_osaka.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: pizza, pasta, beef-cutlet sandwiches and fried lunch plates. Ask about salads and steak.
osaka_passion_et_nature_shin_osaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat-led Italian bar.
osaka_passion_et_nature_shin_osaka.hours_raw: Daily 10:30–22:30 (food last order 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed only when Alde Shin-Osaka closes; shorter hours at New Year (Tabelog; shop site). Lunch until about 16:30, but may end early when food runs out (September 2026). Reservations accepted, and needed in the evening (Tabelog; September 2026). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 34 seats with sofa seating; non-smoking; children welcome, though the shop is wine-led (Tabelog). Sommelier; English menu (Tabelog).
osaka_passion_et_nature_shin_osaka.notes: [Italian · Shin-Osaka Station, natural wine before the Shinkansen] A small, busy bar at the far end of Alde Shin-Osaka, inside the station, with about 250 natural wines picked by staff who visited the makers, and casual meat-led Italian food to match (shop site). Travellers come for a bottle and an appetiser platter, carpaccio or pizza before a train; orders arrive fast (2026). Lunch is hearty Western plates such as hamburg steak with fried shrimp, about ¥1,300 (2026). Book in the evening, when it fills. Open 10:30 to 22:30 every day; English menu.

chef_bio.background: Shop site: Passion et Nature began from a wish to share the lifelong work and feelings of natural-wine makers; every wine is one the staff have experienced first-hand, chosen to suit the food. Tabelog: a sommelier is on staff. Reviewers: friendly staff, varying by person (September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Honmamon" natural wine with food to match, in a casual bar (shop site).
chef_bio.specialty: Natural wine with an appetiser platter; beef-cutlet sandwich.

anecdotes.text: "Located at the far end of Alde, this cozy little shop offers a wide selection of wines, from classics to Japanese varieties, which made me excited to step inside!" — August 2026, appetiser platter and cheese penne.
"Since I had pre-ordered an assortment of appetizers for the number of people in my party, they were served immediately upon our arrival." — September 2026.
"I had the Passion A Mixed Lunch for JPY 1,330. It included a plate with hamburger steak, shrimp fry, and a serving of rice." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パシオン・エ・ナチュール アルデ新大阪駅店、ダイニングバー・ワインバー・イタリアン、大阪市淀川区西中島5-16-1 アルデ新大阪、地下鉄 新大阪駅の中改札 (5番出口) のすぐそば、毎日10:30〜22:30 (L.O. 料理21:30、ドリンク22:00)、休みは施設に準じる、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、34席、ソファ席、禁煙、子ども可 (ワインの店)、ソムリエ、英語のメニュー。店のサイト: 自然派ワインとお肉のイタリアンバル、自然派ワイン約250種類はすべてスタッフがワインを造る人を訪ねて選んだ「ほんまもん」、肩ロースのステーキ、マルゲリータ、前菜盛り、牛カツサンドはマスト、新鮮野菜のサラダ、ランチもいろいろ、テイクアウト。口コミ (2026年8〜10月): アルデのいちばん奥の小さな店、日本のワインも、前菜盛り、カルパッチョ、チーズのペンネ、リゾット、ピザ、パスタ、ハラミ、ランチは16:30までだが売り切れで早じまいも、「Passion A」のミックスランチ (ハンバーグ、エビフライ、ごはん) 1,330円、牛カツとエビフライ、ハンバーグとステーキ、ハンバーグ、エビフライ、コーンクリームコロッケ、ローストビーフ、夜は予約でいっぱい、新幹線の前にさっと、値段はやや高めという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Tabelog lists an English menu; sommelier on staff; station bar used to travellers.
