osaka_men_tsururi_shin_osaka.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon and tempura.
osaka_men_tsururi_shin_osaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the cold broth is made with flying-fish (ago) dashi (October 2026), and toppings include chikuwa tempura and bonito flakes.
osaka_men_tsururi_shin_osaka.hours_raw: Daily 7:00–22:00 (Tabelog). Counter service in a small food court (Ekimaru Kitchen) just outside the JR Shin-Osaka east gate; a buzzer calls you when the bowl is ready, about 7–8 minutes (2026). No reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Busy at peak times (October 2026). Opened 16 March 2021 (Tabelog).
osaka_men_tsururi_shin_osaka.notes: [Udon · Shin-Osaka Station, Himi udon by the Shinkansen gate] A quick-service udon counter in the food court just outside Shin-Osaka's east gate serving Himi udon from Toyama, thin, flat and hand-stretched, slippery and lightly firm (2026). The order is chiku-tama tempura bukkake, cold, with chikuwa and a runny egg tempura in a light flying-fish broth, about ¥1,050 (October 2026). From 7:00 there is a ¥650 breakfast set of udon and a small rice bowl (2026). Order, take a buzzer, and eat in a few minutes before your train. Open daily to 22:00.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 16 March 2021 in the Ekimaru food court at Shin-Osaka Station (Tabelog). Reviewers: Himi udon, one of Japan's three famous udon, rare in Osaka (September–October 2026).

anecdotes.text: "The cold broth, made with flying fish dashi, had a light and pleasant flavor." — October 2026, chiku-tama tempura bukkake for JPY 1,050.
"This udon is made from Himi udon, which is not very common, and the noodles are thin—slightly thicker than somen." — September 2026, chiku-tama tempura udon set, cold.
"I ordered a set of udon and tamago kake gohan (rice with raw egg), which was an incredible deal!" — October 2026, breakfast set for JPY 650.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 麺つるり、うどん、大阪市淀川区西中島5-16-1、JR 新大阪駅の東改札の外、毎日7:00〜22:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、禁煙、子ども可、2021年3月16日オープン、サイト shinosaka.ekimaru.com。口コミ (2026年9〜10月): 改札の外のフードコート、Himi のうどんで細くて平たい手延べ、つるつるで少しコシ、ちく玉天うどん (温かいのも冷たいのも)、ちく玉天ぶっかけ1,050円、冷たいつゆはあごだし、かけうどんと炊き込みごはんのセット920円、かき揚げざるうどん940円、大きなかき揚げの「Gotsu」かき揚げぶっかけ、朝のセット650円 (うどんとかつお節の卵かけごはんか高菜明太)、ごぼうごはんのセット、ブザーで呼ばれる、7〜8分で出る、混む時間あり。

cultural_comfort.note: Food-court counter: order, take a buzzer, collect your tray. No English evidence found.

osaka_zojirushi_ginpaku_bento_shin_osaka.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Bento sides include kara-age, tempura, fritters and hamburg steak; the rice itself is plain.
osaka_zojirushi_ginpaku_bento_shin_osaka.vegan_detail: Ask. There is a vegetarian bento with tofu hamburg steak and vegetables (October 2026), but it also has thick omelette, so it is not vegan as served.
osaka_zojirushi_ginpaku_bento_shin_osaka.hours_raw: Daily 7:30–21:30; may close when the facility does (Tabelog). Takeout only; orders take a few to about ten minutes, so allow time before your train; lines near noon (September 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR accepted; double JR West WESTER points on Wednesdays (Tabelog; August 2026). Opened 16 March 2021 (Tabelog).
osaka_zojirushi_ginpaku_bento_shin_osaka.notes: [Bento · Shin-Osaka Station, flame-cooked-rice bento for the train] Zojirushi, the rice-cooker maker, runs this bento counter outside Shin-Osaka's east gate to show off its rice: everything is cooked in its top cooker, a blend picked to taste good cold (Tabelog shop text). Choose warm white rice or room-temperature brown rice and a bento of Japanese sides, fish, meat or a vegetarian box, ¥1,500–1,750 (2026). Reviewers call it the best rice they have had in a bento; portions are modest and prices not low (2026). Allow ten minutes at lunchtime. Sister to Zojirushi Shokudo in Namba.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog shop text: Zojirushi wants more people to know how good rice can be; all rice is cooked in its high-end "Enbutaiki" rice cooker, and the white rice is an original blend chosen by five-star rice meister Masato Kaneko to stay delicious when cooled. Opened 16 March 2021 (Tabelog). Sister concept of Zojirushi Shokudo (osaka_zojirushi_shokudo_namba).
chef_bio.philosophy: Delicious rice with sides that go with rice (Tabelog shop text).

anecdotes.text: "I had it after a little while, but this was the first time I thought the rice in a bento was so delicious. It was that good!" — October 2026, seafood bento.
"Since it takes a little time from ordering to receiving your meal, I recommend arriving with plenty of time before your Shinkansen departure." — September 2026.
"It featured tofu hamburgers, sautéed vegetables, simmered lotus root, and thick omelets—all visually appealing and delicious." — October 2026, vegetarian bento.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 象印銀白弁当、弁当、大阪市淀川区西中島5-16-1 JR新大阪駅 3F 東改札外、毎日7:30〜21:30、施設の都合で休みも、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、テイクアウト、2021年3月16日オープン。店の紹介: ごはんのほんとうのおいしさを知ってほしい、ごはんはすべて象印の最上位の炊飯ジャー「Enbutaiki」で炊く、白米は五つ星お米マイスター Masato Kaneko が選んだオリジナルブレンドで冷めてもおいしい、ごはんに合うおかず。口コミ (2026年2〜10月): 白米 (温かい) か玄米やhealth-support のお米 (常温)、普通か大盛り (無料)、和風弁当1,500円 (から揚げ、銀鮭の塩焼き、だし巻き、れんこんの天ぷら、青菜)、鶏とハンバーグの弁当1,750円、鮭と白身のフライの弁当、ベジタリアン弁当 (豆腐ハンバーグ、野菜のソテー、れんこんの煮物、厚焼き卵)、Tajima 牛の弁当、なまぶし弁当、注文から受け取りまで少しかかる、昼は行列、量は少なめで値段は安くない、水曜は WESTER ポイント2倍。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeout counter; choose rice type and temperature. No English evidence found.

osaka_buta_nakajima_minamikata_nishinaka.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Skewers come with salt or sauce; tsukune with sauce or cheese (June 2026).
osaka_buta_nakajima_minamikata_nishinaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a pork yakiton restaurant.
osaka_buta_nakajima_minamikata_nishinaka.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30); irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservations recommended; phone to ask for a seat type (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards, e-money and QR accepted; ¥400 a head charge, waived for course bookings (Tabelog). 25 seats with counter; smoking allowed; can be smoky from the grill (Tabelog; August 2026). Order by QR code (June 2026). Opened 2 November 2015 (Tabelog).
osaka_buta_nakajima_minamikata_nishinaka.notes: [Yakiton · Nishinakajima, pork skewers and pork sashimi up a flight of stairs] A small, smoky, always-busy yakiton bar on a second floor near Nishinakajima-Minamigata, all about pork (2026). Start with the seasonal vegetables and miso, try the low-temperature pork sashimi platter (tongue, stomach, heart and uterus), then order the omakase five skewers, with the rich harami and the "kimo-spe" liver as favourites (2026). About ¥4,000–5,000 a head; ¥400 cover unless you book a course. Book ahead; smoking allowed. Open every night to midnight.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog beyond a note on its sister shop, PIZZA Ichiro, a stone-oven vegetable-pizza shop in Nishinakajima; opened 2 November 2015 (Tabelog). Operator brand page: butanaka.com. Reviewers: yakiton is rare in Kansai (August 2026).

anecdotes.text: "Personally, I really enjoyed the harami (pork skirt)." — June 2026, five-kind yakitori platter.

"This dish allows you to savor rare cuts of pork as sashimi, including tongue, stomach, heart, and uterus, making it fun to compare the different offerings of the day." — August 2026, four-kind sashimi platter.
"The fat was so tasty that I couldn't stop eating!" — August 2026, first yakiton.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 豚中島南方、居酒屋・焼き鳥・焼肉、大阪市淀川区西中島4-7-8 サンコープラザ 2F、西中島南方駅から徒歩2分、阪急 南方駅から徒歩3分、毎日17:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:30)、不定休、予約可 (席の種類は電話で)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、チャージ1人400円 (コース予約はなし)、25席、喫煙可、飲み放題のコース、2015年11月2日オープン、姉妹店に石窯の野菜のピザの「PIZZA Ichiro」、ブランドのサイト butanaka.com。口コミ (2026年6〜10月): 豚の焼きとん、注文は QR、お通しは季節の野菜と味噌、おまかせ5本は同じ部位が5本ずつ、豚ハラミ、「kimo-spe」、つくねはタレかチーズ、低温調理の豚の刺身の4種盛り (タン、ガツ、ハツ、子宮)、自家製のもつ煮込み、煙が多い、席はせまい、いつも満席なので予約を、ひとり約4,000〜5,000円、関西では焼きとんはめずらしい。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by QR code; book ahead; smoky and smoking allowed. No English evidence found.

osaka_sushi_to_wa_mochizuki.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sushi with the shop's own blend of red vinegar and soy sauce; Japanese dishes such as matsukasa-age and chawanmushi; udon for children.
osaka_sushi_to_wa_mochizuki.hours_raw: Daily except Wednesday 18:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00); closed Wednesdays (Tabelog). Weekend lunch from 12:00 by reservation (Tabelog; 2024–2025 reviews). Reservation only; groups of 6 or more by phone (Tabelog). Opened August 8, 2023 at this address (Tabelog); the chef earlier worked at Sushi Akazu and at a previous location (2025 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Children welcome, with free udon and children's sets; surprise cakes on request (Tabelog). All-you-can-drink with the course (June 2025).
osaka_sushi_to_wa_mochizuki.notes: [Sushi · between Kitashinchi and Fukushima, red-vinegar sushi from a kappo cook] An eight-seat sushi counter up a small alley between Kitashinchi and Fukushima, opened in 2023 by Chef Mochizuki after leaving Sushi Akazu, with a background in Japanese cuisine that shows in the side dishes: shirako chawanmushi with crab sauce, matsukasa-age, sea-urchin rice. The nigiri sit on a red-vinegar rice with a house soy sauce. The omakase is listed at ¥19,800, though diners have paid ¥15,000–16,500, and there is a weekend lunch at ¥10,000. Families are welcome, with free udon for children. Closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): fish chosen from all over Japan with a unique blend of red vinegar and soy sauce; dishes by a chef with a background in traditional Japanese cuisine; seasonal omakase; sake the owner tastes personally. Opened August 8, 2023. Reviews: "A restaurant by Chef Mochizuki, independent from Sushi Akazu" (February 2025); a diner who knew the previous location (May 2025); a background in Japanese cuisine shows in both the sushi and the side dishes (December 2025).

anecdotes.text: "The appetizer was bonito, lightly seared and served with mustard." — February 2025.
"The sea urchin mixed rice and Matsukasa-age were dishes I could have eaten endlessly." — May 2025.
"The sushi is primarily made with red vinegar, giving it a slightly stronger flavor." — September 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Friendly chef at the counter (2025–2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

osaka_komugi_ya_fukushima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon, tempura and breaded katsudon.
osaka_komugi_ya_fukushima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: bonito-forward broth; beef, chicken and egg toppings.
osaka_komugi_ya_fukushima.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 7:30–10:00 (breakfast) and 10:55–15:00; closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash or PayPay; no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 14 counter seats; no smoking 11:30–14:00, separate smoking times otherwise (Tabelog). Lunch queues of about five, rarely over 10 minutes (2026). One woman ran the shop alone at breakfast (August and October 2026).
osaka_komugi_ya_fukushima.notes: [Udon · Fukushima, udon from 7:30 am] A fourteen-seat udon counter by JR Fukushima Station that opens for breakfast at 7:30, one of the few non-chain places in Osaka to do so, with kake udon and an egg-over-rice set for ¥580. The Sanuki-style noodles are boiled to order and properly chewy, the broth leans on bonito, and the tempura is fried fresh: the beef-and-vegetable bukkake is the cold favourite at ¥950, and the katsudon has fans of its own. Lunch brings a short queue of office workers. One woman ran the counter alone on recent mornings; cash or PayPay only; weekdays only.

roles: Owner (unnamed), a woman who runs mornings alone (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Reviews: the woman owner was working alone at breakfast (August 2026); "It's run by just one mother" (October 2026); a long-running lunch favourite since at least 2019 (July 2026). The Tabelog listing is not shop-maintained.

anecdotes.text: "The taste was absolutely delicious." — August 2026, on udon boiled and tempura fried to order.
"It's true that there are few places in Osaka that serve breakfast outside of chain restaurants." — October 2026.
"The Katsudon was just as tasty as I remembered." — July 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Counter-only local shop (2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (not shop-maintained); reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_mealthy_fukushima.gf_detail: Some GF options: the official menu marks the immunity-boost plate, a spicy dry curry, as gluten-free (¥1,700). Other plates include fried tatsuta mackerel and croquettes; cross-contact is not described, so ask.
osaka_mealthy_fukushima.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: a Vegan Plate of two croquettes in a Buddha bowl (¥1,900), also as a takeaway Vegan Bowl (official site). Other plates use chicken, mackerel and pork.
osaka_mealthy_fukushima.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–14:30 (last order 14:00); closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays, with special openings once or twice a month announced on Instagram (Tabelog; official site). No table reservations on weekdays; bento and takeout by phone or Instagram message until 9:00 the same day (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog). Cards, iD, QUICPay, QR codes (Tabelog). 13 seats: 5 at the counter and tables for 2, 2 and 4; non-smoking; children welcome; takeout and delivery (Tabelog). Self-serve rooibos tea and a small green juice with the meal (December 2025; February 2026).
osaka_mealthy_fukushima.notes: [Healthy lunch · Fukushima, dietitian-designed plates with vegan and GF choices] A thirteen-seat weekday lunch spot near JR Fukushima whose plates are designed with a registered dietitian: a main, five small sides, miso soup and brown or mixed-grain rice, with a shot of green juice first and rooibos on tap. The menu marks a gluten-free spicy dry curry and offers a Vegan Plate, a Buddha bowl with two croquettes, alongside beauty, gut-health and protein plates and a monthly special. Plates are ¥1,700 (vegan ¥1,900); bento for takeaway can be ordered by Instagram message. Regulars come every month; there can be a short queue after 1 pm.

chef_bio.chef_name: 立花真由美 (representative of the operating company)
roles: A registered dietitian and food specialist who supervise the menu (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Official site: Mealthy, run by Diversity Co. (representative 立花真由美), "helping protect health and beauty from within", using seasonal vegetables and balanced nutrition; a news post describes it as a healthy-food shop using organic vegetables, and the shop has supervised a kitchen-car menu. Tabelog: "Healthy, Delicious, Merci!", with plates supervised by a nutritionist and food specialist.
chef_bio.specialty: Vegan Plate; gluten-free dry curry; monthly plate.

anecdotes.text: "The tea served was rooibos, and it was self-serve with unlimited refills—what a delight!" — December 2025.
"The gratin is made with soy milk, and it has no strong aftertaste, just rich and creamy." — December 2025.
"the price has increased from JPY 1,400 to JPY 1,700 due to rising costs." — February 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: Mealthy、ダイバーシティー株式会社 (代表 立花真由美) が運営、季節の野菜と栄養バランスにこだわる。メニューは月替わり、美肌、腸活、ヴィーガン (2種のコロッケのブッダボウル1,900円)、免疫力アップ (こく旨スパイシードライカレー、グルテンフリー)、身体作りの各プレート、ほかは1,700円、テイクアウトも同じ内容。ランチ11:00〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)、土日祝休み。

cultural_comfort.note: Menu with photos and detailed dish descriptions (Tabelog; December 2025). No English evidence found.

The official menu lists a Vegan Plate, a two-croquette Buddha bowl, ¥1,900, and a takeaway Vegan Bowl.

osaka_izakaya_tokitame.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Menu includes tempura, fried eggplant, tako chijimi and ponzu dishes.
osaka_izakaya_tokitame.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood and dashi-based obanzai; cucumber and myoga with salted kombu appears among the small dishes.
osaka_izakaya_tokitame.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat 17:30–24:00 (food last order 22:30, drinks 23:30); Sun and holidays 16:30–23:00 (food last order 21:30); closed Wednesdays and about one other day a month; hours may change (Tabelog). Often fully booked; same-day bookings may get a call back if a seat frees up (February 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 18 seats: 8 at the counter, 10 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog).
osaka_izakaya_tokitame.notes: [Izakaya · Fukushima, the reliable obanzai izakaya] An eighteen-seat izakaya near JR Fukushima that diners call the place to go when in doubt: a long menu where everything lands, from an obanzai platter and thick fried tofu to seared bluefin tataki, hamo tempura, hairy crab and a mackerel sushi to finish. Seasonal fish like hamo and young ayu appear in summer, sake runs to Matsuno Tsukasa, and a sansho soda can be made with imo shochu. One diner notes it has been in the Michelin Guide yet stays unpretentious and reasonable. Book ahead; closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: Reviews (2026): consistently high-quality dishes across a broad menu; attentive but not intrusive service; an October 2026 diner says restaurants featured in the Michelin Guide often struggle afterward but this one stays unpretentious and reasonably priced (the diner's remark). The Tabelog listing is not shop-maintained.

anecdotes.text: "I always order the final touch, the mackerel sushi!" — July 2026.
"The standout was definitely the Grilled Tuna Tataki. The smoky aroma was prominent" — August 2026.
"if I'm ever in doubt in Fukushima, this is definitely the place to go. No mistakes here!" — August 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Counter and tables; attentive service (2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (not shop-maintained); reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_iso_ichi_shin_osaka.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Fried shrimp, croquettes and tempura are battered; sashimi, simmered fish and clay-pot rice need checking for soy sauce.
osaka_iso_ichi_shin_osaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya; dashi and fish throughout.
osaka_iso_ichi_shin_osaka.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); Fridays and days before holidays to 24:00; closed 31 December–2 January (Tabelog). Reservations for dinner; groups of 10 or more by phone; no lunch bookings (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 86 seats, counter, sunken-kotatsu and semi-private rooms for 4–8; banquets up to 62 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Orders by QR code at the table (October 2026). Opened 30 May 2009 (Tabelog).
osaka_iso_ichi_shin_osaka.notes: [Izakaya · Shin-Osaka, morning-catch fish near the station, and a cheap fish lunch] An 86-seat seafood izakaya in the Nissei building two minutes from the Midosuji Line’s Shin-Osaka, with fish sent the same morning from ports around Japan. The house dish is a clay pot of rice with wild nodoguro (order it early: about 40 minutes), alongside sashimi platters and simmered kinmedai; autumn brings sanma and matsutake dobin-mushi (2026). Lunch is the bargain: grilled fish or fried shrimp sets around ¥1,000–1,180 with free rice and egg. Calm semi-private rooms suit business dinners before the Shinkansen. Open daily to 23:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: fresh fish delivered from fishing ports across Japan; three signature dishes, natural nodoguro clay-pot rice, the Isonori platter and "zukushi" cuisine; a monthly special plan; banquets for up to 62. One of three Iso Ichi shops with 山田 and 江坂 (Gurunavi, web search 2026-11-02). Per reviews: "The new Shinosaka location provides the same reassuring quality that comes with being a sister restaurant" (October 2026, a regular of the Esaka shop); "the staff were helpful in recommending dishes" (August 2026); "the staff kindly informed me that [the shop has] white rice on the menu" (October 2026); a diner wished for staff instead of QR ordering (October 2026); prices on the high side for an Osaka izakaya (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Fish chosen and cooked to bring out the ingredient (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "Nodoguro Kamameshi (please note it takes 40 minutes)." — October 2026.
"For lunch, I chose grilled fish, which included two half fillets of hokke and mackerel. At JPY 1,180..." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 旬魚菜 磯一 新大阪店、居酒屋・海鮮・鍋、大阪市淀川区宮原3-4-30 ニッセイ新大阪ビル 1F、御堂筋線新大阪駅から徒歩2分、JR 新大阪駅から7分、毎日11:30〜14:30、17:00〜23:00、金・祝前日は24:00まで、12月31日〜1月2日休み、昼は予約不可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、86席、半個室、掘りごたつ、禁煙、2009年5月30日オープン、全国の漁港から朝獲れの鮮魚、3大名物は天然のどぐろの土鍋めし、磯盛り、づくし料理、宴会は62名まで。口コミ (2026年): 新大阪・山田・江坂の系列、江坂店の姉妹店、のどぐろの釜めしは40分、刺身盛り、キンメの煮付け、カツオのたたき、さんま、松茸の土瓶蒸し、カニ、くじら、グラタン、アボカドとチーズ、飲み放題つきコース約5,000円、昼は焼き魚定食1,180円 (ほっけとさば)、エビフライとエビクリームコロッケの定食、ごはんおかわり自由、生卵1個無料、具だくさんの豚汁、QR コードで注文、日本酒。

cultural_comfort.note: QR-code ordering at the table (October 2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_m_and_deli_shin_osaka.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: breaded beef katsu in toasted bread with sauce.
osaka_m_and_deli_shin_osaka.hours_raw: Daily 6:30–21:00 (Tabelog; shop site). Take-away only, inside the Shinkansen ticket gates in ASTY Shin-Osaka (Tabelog; site). No cards; transport IC cards and QR accepted (Tabelog); Suica used (October 2026). Opened in 2010, per an August 2026 review.
osaka_m_and_deli_shin_osaka.notes: [Sandwich · Shin-Osaka Station, Matsusaka beef katsu sandwiches for the Shinkansen] A take-away stand inside the Shin-Osaka Shinkansen gates selling one thing above all: the Nakanoshima beef sandwich of 100% Matsusaka beef, layered lean and marbled slices fried as a mille-feuille katsu with sweet sauce and mustard in toasted bread (¥1,450, 2026). It holds up well cold, which is the point: most buy it to eat on the train. Diners split on value, but it outsells the bento queues. Open 6:30–21:00; IC cards and QR, no credit cards.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop site (mdeli.jp, read 2026-11-02): the Nakanoshima beef sandwich was born at "M デリ＆バーガー" in Nakanoshima; over 3.5 million sold; the company stations a buyer in Mie and buys whole Matsusaka cattle; run by 株式会社ライトハウス; shops at ASTY Shin-Osaka and a sales counter at ASTY Kyoto. Per reviews: Lighthouse "also runs Yakiniku restaurants like Matsusaka Beef Yakiniku M" and the stand opened in 2010 (August 2026); one diner called the value "the worst" (July 2026), another found the batter thick and the fat heavy (June 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: A cutlet suits sauce, as kushi-age shows: a slightly sweet sauce with mustard made for the beef katsu (site, translated).

anecdotes.text: "Even when cold, the bread remained moist, and the meat was astonishingly tender, making it the perfect indulgent treat during my travels." — September 2026.
"The 100% Matsusaka Beef Sandwich features layers of tender meat arranged in a mille-feuille style, cut into bite-sized pieces." — October 2026.
"While other bento shops were crowded, this one had a shorter line." — July 2026, ¥1,450.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 店のサイト (mdeli.jp): M&DELI、松阪牛専門店、中之島ビーフサンド、大阪中之島の「Mデリ＆バーガー」から誕生した松阪牛100%のビーフサンド、累計350万個、三重に仕入れ担当を置き松阪牛を一頭買い、霜降りと赤身を何層にも重ねて一枚ずつ衣をつけて揚げたビーフカツ、少し甘めのソースにカラシ、軽くトーストしたパン、JR 新大阪駅 ASTY 新大阪 (新幹線改札内) 6:30〜21:00、ASTY 京都にも販売店、株式会社ライトハウス。食べログ: M&DELI JR新大阪駅店、サンドイッチ、テイクアウトのみ、カード不可、交通系電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2022年〜2026年10月): 1,450円、ハーフとレギュラー、限定のコロッケサンド、新幹線で食べる、冷めてもおいしい、2010年オープン、松阪牛焼肉 M も運営、割高という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Shop site has an English page (read 2026-11-02); grab-and-go counter. No English evidence from reviews.

osaka_kaisen_shokudo_owest_shin_osaka.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Kara-age, tempura, chicken katsu and fries are battered; sashimi and seafood bowls come with soy-based sauce.
osaka_kaisen_shokudo_owest_shin_osaka.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–24:00 (last order 23:00), straight through the afternoon (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day cancellations charged in full for courses and ¥4,000 a head for tables (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR, including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 72 seats, 30 of them sunken kotatsu, shoes off (Tabelog; September 2026). Smoking allowed, except 11:30–13:00 (Tabelog; October 2026). No call button: wave to order (2026). Opened 1 June 2016 (Tabelog).
osaka_kaisen_shokudo_owest_shin_osaka.notes: [Izakaya · Shin-Osaka east exit, thick-cut sashimi from midday to midnight] A 72-seat seafood izakaya two minutes from the JR Shin-Osaka east exit, open straight through from 11:30 to midnight, so it is the place for a daytime drink by the station (2026). The draw is sashimi cut thick with sharp edges, platters with all-you-can-drink, and autumn sanma three ways; lunch sets are ¥1,100 with free large rice. Busy and loud, with shoes-off sunken seating; smoking is allowed after 13:00, and you call the staff by hand. Cards and QR accepted.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: seafood izakaya and Japanese food; opened 1 June 2016. One of three おーうえすと shops with 東三国 and 千里中央 はなれ (Gurunavi, Hot Pepper; web search 2026-11-02). Per reviews: "If you’re looking to drink in Shin Osaka during the day, Ouesuto is the only choice" (August 2026); "The staff, possibly the manager or a cook, were incredibly kind" (August 2026); no call button, so ordering can take a while (August–September 2026); one returning diner found the fried food poor and the service slipping (September 2026).

anecdotes.text: "What stood out the most was the thick, fresh sashimi with sharp edges. It was exquisite." — October 2026.
"In a city where there are few places open late at night, this restaurant is a rare find!" — August 2026.
"I enjoyed the seasonal sanma (mackerel pike) prepared in three different ways." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 新大阪 海鮮食堂 おーうえすと、居酒屋・海鮮・日本料理、大阪市東淀川区東中島1-20-2 アネシス新大阪 1F、JR 新大阪駅東口から徒歩2分、毎日11:30〜24:00 (L.O.23:00)、予約可、当日キャンセルはコース100%、席のみはひとり4,000円、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、72席 (うち掘りごたつ30)、喫煙可 (11:30〜13:00は全席禁煙)、2016年6月1日オープン。ぐるなび: 名物の蒼天シメサバ造り。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年10月): 厚切りの刺身の盛り合わせ、昼は3種から1,100円、海鮮丼は甘い醤油、大盛り無料、貝の焼き物、さんまの三種、いくらの海鮮サラダ、天ぷらの盛り合わせ、うなぎの寿司、唐揚げ、スモークのポテトサラダ、刺身つきの飲み放題、昼飲み、呼び出しボタンなし、にぎやか、喫煙可。

cultural_comfort.note: Alipay and WeChat Pay accepted (Tabelog); no call button. No English evidence found.

osaka_kissa_sancho_shin_osaka.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: sandwiches, toast, Baumkuchen, demi-glace and fried dishes.
osaka_kissa_sancho_shin_osaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steak, ginger pork, egg sandwiches, cream.
osaka_kissa_sancho_shin_osaka.hours_raw: Daily 7:20–21:00 (Tabelog). No reservations; seated strictly in order of arrival (Tabelog; February 2026). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 40 seats, three at the counter facing the kitchen and tables along the wall (Tabelog; April 2026). Smoking allowed at every seat (Tabelog; 2026). Full at lunch, with people turned away (May and September 2026).
osaka_kissa_sancho_shin_osaka.notes: [Kissa · Shin-Osaka Station, a Showa kissa for smokers, from breakfast to dinner] A 40-seat coffee shop in the Aji no Koji arcade on the ground floor of Shin-Osaka Station, just outside the gates, keeping a Showa-era room where smoking is still allowed at every table (2026). Mornings bring sets from ¥750 and sandwiches with fruit; at lunch it fills with demi-glace hamburg steak and ginger pork sets, and the afternoon favourite is burnt Baumkuchen with cream and a strong coffee (¥850 set). Seating is strictly in order of arrival. Open 7:20–21:00; PayPay only. Non-smokers be warned.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: kissa, café and yoshoku; breakfast; smoking allowed. Per reviews: "a charming retro café that remains a smoking establishment, bustling with customers from morning till night" (April 2026); "[The staff] guide customers to [the] seats strictly in the order of arrival" (February 2026); "a classic coffee shop that exudes a Showa retro atmosphere" (August 2026); two diners left or kept it short because of the smoke (July and October 2026).

anecdotes.text: "The burnt version comes with whipped cream, and it was delicious—not too sweet, just right." — April 2026, Baumkuchen set ¥850.
"No matter how busy it gets or how mismatched the number of seats and customers may be, [the staff] stick to this system without hesitation." — February 2026.
"The hustle and bustle of the platform fades away, creating a relaxing atmosphere." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 喫茶サンチョ、喫茶店・カフェ・洋食、大阪市淀川区西中島5-16-1 JR東海新大阪駅 1F 味の小路、毎日7:20〜21:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay 可、40席、喫煙可、モーニングあり。口コミ (2025年〜2026年11月): 改札の外、エスカレーターで1階へ、昭和レトロの喫茶店、全席喫煙可、来た順に案内、モーニングセット C 750円、ツナときゅうりとレタスのサンドとフルーツ、コーヒーつきランチ、デミグラスのハンバーグ、しょうが焼き定食、ごはんおかわり自由、飲み物なしは50円引き、バウムクーヘンのセット850円 (焦がしバウムクーヘンと生クリーム)、コーヒー650円、フルーツみつまめ、わらび餅、果汁100%のミックスジュース、カフェオレ、昼は満席で断られる人も。

cultural_comfort.note: Seated in order of arrival; smoking everywhere (2026). No English evidence found.
